This then shall be my only plea
Christ Jesus lived and died for me.

songs.title: The Unveiled Christ
lyrics: [C]Once our blessed Christ of beauty [G]Was veiled off from human [C]view;
[C]But through suffering, death and sorrow [Dm7]He has rent the [G7]veil in [C]two.
[F]O behold the Man of [C]Sorrows, [F]O [D7]behold Him in plain [G7]view;
[C]Lo! He [D7]is the [C]mighty [F]Conqueror, [C]Since He [G]rent the veil in [C]two.
[F]Lo! He is the mighty [C]Conqueror, [G]Since He [G7]rent the veil in [C]two.
Yes, He is with God, the Father,
For He is the Well beloved
Since He rent the veil in two.
Men of earth give praises due;
For He is the mighty Conqueror
Since He rent the veil in two.

songs.title: The Wonders of Redeeming Love
lyrics: The Son of God comes from above
He gives Himself, His life, His all,
For man He drains the cup of gall,
And now before His Father's face
For those who seek the throne of grace
He knows the frailties of our frame,
For He has borne our grief;
Our great High Priest once felt the same,
His love will not be satisfied,
The faithful ones for whom He died

songs.title: O Listen to Our Wondrous Story
lyrics: No angel could His place have taken,
Highest of the high tho' he;
The loved One on the cross forsaken
Was One of the Godhead three!
Will you surrender to this Savior?
You, too, shall come to know His favor,
He will save you, save you now.

songs.title: Does Jesus Care?
lyrics: [C]Does Jesus care [F]when my [C]heart is pained Too [G]deeply for mirth or [C]song,
[C]As the burdens press, and the [F]cares distress And the [C]way grows [G]weary and [C]long?
[C]Oh [G7]yes, He cares, I [C]know He cares, His [G]heart is [D7]touched with my [G]grief;
[G7]When [C]the days are weary, the [F]long nights dreary, I [C]know my [G]Savior [C]cares.
Does Jesus care when my way is dark
With a nameless dread and fear?
As the daylight fades into deep night shades,
Does He care enough to be near?
Does Jesus care when I've said goodbye
To the dearest on earth to me,
And my sad heart aches till it nearly breaks?
Is it aught to Him? Does He see?

songs.title: Christ Is Alive
lyrics: Christ is alive!  No longer bound
He comes to claim the here and now
And conquer every place and time.
In every insult, rift, and war
Where color, scorn or wealth divide,
He suffers still, yet loves the more,
He rules the world His Father made,
Till, in the end, His love adored
Shall be to all on earth displayed.

songs.title: I Will Sing of Jesus' Love
lyrics: [A]I will sing of [E7]Jesus' [A]love, Sing [E7]of Him, [D]who first [A]loved me;
[A7]I will [D]sing of [A]Jesus' [E]love Endless praise my heart shall give;
[F#m]He has died [Db]that I [D]might live I will [A]sing His [E7]love to [A]me.
O the depths of love divine!
Earth or heaven can never know
How that sin as dark as mine
can be made as white as snow.
Nothing good for Him I've done;
How could He such love bestow?
Lord, I own my heart is won,
help me now my love to show.

songs.title: Jesus Paid It All
lyrics: [D]I hear the Savior say, "Thy [A]strength indeed is [D]small;
[D]Child of weakness, watch and pray, Find in [A]Me thine all in [D]all."
[D]Jesus paid it all, All to Him I [A]owe;
[D]Sin had left a crimson [G]stain, [E7]He [A]washed it white as [D]snow.
Lord, now indeed I find Thy power and Thine alone,
Can change the leper's spots And melt the heart of stone.
Since nothing good have I Whereby Thy grace to claim,
I'll wash my garments white In the blood of Calv'ry's Lamb.
And when before the throne I stand in Him complete,
I'll lay my trophies down All down at Jesus' feet.

songs.title: Jesus Is All the World to Me
lyrics: [G]Jesus is [C]all the [D]world to [G]me, My life, my [D]joy, my [G]all;
[G]He [D]is my strength from [G]day to day, [A7]Without Him I would [D]fall.
When I am sad to Him I go; No other one can cheer me so;
[Em]When I am [Eb7]sad [G]He makes me glad, He's [D7]my [G]Friend.
Jesus is all the world to me, my friend in trials sore;
I go to him for blessings, and he gives them o'er and o'er.
He sends the sunshine and the rain, he sends the harvest's golden grain;
sunshine and rain, harvest of grain, he's my friend.
Jesus is all the world to me, and true to him I'll be;
O how could I this friend deny, when he's so true to me?
Following him I know I'm right, he watches o'er me day and night;
following him by day and night, he's my friend.
Jesus is all the world to me, I want no better friend;
I trust him now, I'll trust him when life's fleeting days shall end.
Beautiful life with such a friend, beautiful life that has no end;
eternal life, eternal joy, he's my friend.

songs.title: I've Found a Friend
lyrics: [G]I've found a Friend; oh, [D7]such a Friend! He loved me ere I [G]knew Him;
He drew me with the [C]cords of love, And [G]thus He [D7]bound me to [G]Him.
And '[D7]round my heart still [G]closely twine Those [C]ties which [A]nought can [G]sever,
I've found a Friend; oh, such a Friend!  He bled, He died to save me;
And not alone the gift of life, But His own self He gave me.
Nought that I have my own I call, I hold it for the Giver;
My heart, my strength, my life my all, Are His, and His forever.
I've found a Friend; oh, such a Friend!  All power to Him is given;
To guard me on my upward course, And bring me safe to heaven.
The eternal glories gleam afar, To nerve my faint endeavor;
So now to watch, to work, to war, And then to rest forever.
I've found a Friend; oh, such a Friend!  So kind, and true, and tender,
So wise a counselor and guide, So mighty a defender.
From Him, who loveth me so well, What power my soul can sever?
Shall life or death, or earth, or hell?  No; I am His forever.

songs.title: Jesus, What a Friend for Sinners
lyrics: [G]Jesus! what a [D]Friend for [G]sinners! Jesus! Lover of [D7]my [G]soul;
Friends may fail me, [D]foes [G]assail [C]me, [G]He, my Savior, makes [D7]me [G]whole.
Jesus! what a Strength in weakness!  Let me hide myself in Him.
Tempted, tried, and sometimes failing, He, my Strength, my victory wins.
Jesus! what a Help in sorrow!  While the billows over me roll,
Even when my heart is breaking, He, my Comfort, helps my soul.
Jesus! I do now receive Him, More than all in Him I find.
He hath granted me forgiveness, I am His, and He is mine.

songs.title: My Song Is Love Unknown
lyrics: My song is love unknown, My Savior's love to me,
Love to the loveless shown, That they might lovely be.
O who am I that for my sake My Lord should take frail flesh and die?
He came from His blest throne, Salvation to bestow,
But men made strange, and none The longed for Christ would know.
But O my Friend, my Friend indeed Who at my need His life did spend.
Sometimes they strew His way, And His sweet praises sing,
Resounding all the day, Hosannas to their King.
Then "Crucify" is all their breath, And for His death they thirst and cry.
Why, what hath my Lord done?  What makes this rage and spite?
He made the lame to run, He gave the blind their sight.
Sweet injuries! yet they at these Themselves displease, and 'gainst Him rise.
They rise, and needs will have My dear Lord made away;
A murderer they save, The Prince of life they slay.
Yet cheerful He to suff'ring goes, That He His foes from thence might free.
Here might I stay and sing, No story so divine
Never was love, dear King, Never was grief like Thine!
This is my Friend, in whose sweet praise I all my days could gladly spend.

songs.title: All That Thrills My Soul
lyrics: [G]Who can cheer the heart like [C]Jesus, [D7]By His presence all [G]divine?
[G]True and tender, pure and [C]precious, [D7]Oh, how blest to call Him [G]mine!
[G]All that [B7]thrills my [Em]soul is [B7]Jesus; [A7]He is more than life to [D]me; (to [D7]me;)
[G]And the [G7]fairest of ten [C]thousand, [D7]In my blessed Lord I [G]see.
Love of Christ so freely given, Grace of God beyond degree,
Mercy higher than the heaven, Deeper than the deepest sea.
Every need His hand supplying, Every good in Him I see;
On His strength divine relying, He is All in All to me.
By the crystal flowing river With the ransomed I will sing,
And forever and forever Praise and glorify the King

songs.title: Jesus Loves Me
lyrics: [C]Jesus loves me! This I know, [F]For the Bible [C]tells me [G]so;
[C]Little ones to Him belong, [F]They are [C]weak but [G]He is [C]strong.
[C]Jesus loves [G7]me! [C]this I [C7]know, [F]For the Bible tells [C]me so;
[C]Jesus, take [G7]this [C]heart of [C7]mine, [F]Make it pure and [C]wholly thine;
[C]On the cross [G7]You [C]died for [C7]me, [F]I will [C]love and [G7]live for [C]Thee.

songs.title: O Shepherd Divine
lyrics: [D]O Shepherd divine, I know Thou art mine; Thy [A7]search in the night was for [D]me.
[D]This bleak world is cold, but warm is Thy fold; My [A7]Shepherd, I follow [D]Thee.
[D]Thro' pastures serene, Thro' valleys of green, My [A7]Shepherd, I follow [D]Thee.
O Shepherd divine, I know Thou art mine;
Thy great heart was broken for me.
Thy grace and Thy law I picture in awe;
Ah! life that was given to ransom my soul,
Ah! heart that was broken to make sinners whole,
This world is but loss In view of Thy cross,
O Shepherd divine, I know Thou art mine;
I hear Thee say, "Follow thou Me."
Thy message today illumines my way;
I thrill at Thy marvelous love to Thy sheep,
The way Thou dost lead to the still waters deep,
One staff and one rod, One fold and one God,

songs.title: Savior, Teach Me
lyrics: Savior, teach me day by day, Love's sweet lesson to obey,
Sweeter lesson cannot be, Loving Him who first loved me.
With a child's glad heart of love, At Thy bidding may I move,
Prompt to serve and follow Thee, Loving Him who first loved me.
Teach me I am not my own, I am Thine, and Thine alone;
Thine to keep, to rule, to save From all sin that would enslave.
Love in loving finds employ, In obedience all her joy;
Ever new that joy will be, Loving Him who first loved me.
Teach me thus Thy steps to trace, Strong to follow in Thy grace.
Learning how to love from Thee, Loving Him who first loved me.

songs.title: Sing We of the Modern City
lyrics: In the city full of people,
World of speed and hectic days,
Of the latest trend and craze,
Christ is present, and among us;
In the crowd we see Him stand.
In the bustle of the city
God is not remote in heaven,
But on earth to share our shame,
Changing graph and mass and number

songs.title: Showers of Blessing
lyrics: [G]"There shall be [D]showers of [G]blessing;" [D]This is the promise of [G]love;
[G]Showers of blessing, Showers of blessing we [D]need;
[G7]Mercy drops [C]round us are [G]falling, [D7]But for the showers we [G]plead.
Over the hills and the valleys,
Send them upon us, O Lord;
Grant to us now a refreshing;
Come, and now honor Thy word.
O that today they might fall,
Now as to God were confessing,
Now as on Jesus we call!

songs.title: Tell Me the Old, Old Story
lyrics: [A]Tell me the old, old [D]story, Of [F#m]unseen things [Esus]above[E],
[A]Tell me the old, old [D]story, [E7]Tell me the old, old [A]story,
Tell me the story softly, with earnest tones and grave;
Remember I'm the sinner whom Jesus came to save.
Tell me the story always, if you would really be,
In any time of trouble, a comforter to me.
Tell me the same old story when you have cause to fear
That this world's empty glory is costing me too dear.
Yes, and when that world's glory is dawning on my soul,
Tell me the old, old story "Christ Jesus makes thee whole."

songs.title: The King of Love My Shepherd Is
lyrics: Where streams of living water flow
And, where the verdant pastures grow,
Perverse and foolish, oft I strayed,
But yet in love He sought me,
And on His shoulder gently laid,
And so through all the length of days
Good Shepherd! I would sing Thy praise

songs.title: And Can It Be?
lyrics: My chains fell [D]off, [Am]my [G]heart [C]was [A7]free, I [D]rose, went [G]forth, and [C]followed [D]thee.
Bold I ap-[D]proach [Am]the [G]eternal [C]throne, [A7]And [D]claim the [G]crown, through [C]Christ my [D]own.

songs.title: The Head That Once Was Crowned
lyrics: The head that once was crowned with thorns
The highest place that heaven affords
Is His, is His by right;
The King of kings, and Lord of lords,
The joy of all who dwell above,
To whom He manifests His love,
And grants His name to know.
To them the cross, with all its shame,
With all its grace is given;
Their joy the joy of heaven.

songs.title: The Lord Is Coming
lyrics: The Lord is coming, let this be
And when we meet and when we part
The Lord is coming, let this be
The Lord is coming! sound it forth
From east to west, from south to north;
Speed on! speed on the tidings glad,
That none who love Him may be sad.
The Lord is coming, swift and sure
And all His judgments shall endure,
And none can hope to escape
His wrath, Who walk not in the narrow path.
This earth, with her ten thousand wrongs
Will soon be tuned to nobler songs;
Our praise shall then, in realms of light,

songs.title: Christ Is Coming
lyrics: Earth can now but tell the story
Of Thy bitter cross and pain;
She shall yet behold Thy glory
When Thou comest back to reign;
Christ is coming! Christ is coming!
Let each heart repeat the strain.
Let each heart repeat the strain.
Onward roll from tongue to tongue
Christ is coming! Christ is coming!

songs.title: Hail Him the King of Glory
lyrics: [D7]Earth's darkest night will [G]fade with the dawning, [D]Jesus will soon [G]appear.
Nations again in strife and commotion,
Signs in the heavens, unerring omens,
Children of God look up with rejoicing;
Bless'd are they who, waiting and watching,

songs.title: This Is the Threefold Truth
lyrics: Christ had died! Christ has risen!
Which, if we hold it fast,
And brings us home at last.

songs.title: Come, Thou Long Expected Jesus
lyrics: Born thy people to deliver, born a child and yet a King,
born to reign in us forever, now thy gracious kingdom bring.
By thine own eternal spirit rule in all our hearts alone;
by thine all sufficient merit, raise us to thy glorious throne.

songs.title: Gleams of the Golden Morning
lyrics: [F]To take His faithful and [C7]happy [F]children [C7]To their [F]promised home.
[F]O, we see the gleams of the golden [Bb]morning [C]Piercing [C7]through this [F]night of gloom!
[F]O, we see the gleams of the golden morning [C7]That will [F]burst [C7]the [F]tomb.
The gospel summons will soon be carried
The Bridegroom then will cease to tarry
Attended by all the shining angels,
the Judge will come, and will take his people
The lov'd of earth who have long been parted,
The tears of those who are broken hearted

songs.title: Face to Face
lyrics: [A]Face to face with Christ my [Bm7]Saviour, Face to face, what will it [A]be,
[E7]Face to face shall [A]I behold Him, [E]Far [B7]beyond the starry [E]sky;
[A]Face to face in all His [D]glory [Ebdim7]I shall [A]see Him [Dbm]by [E7]and [A]by!
Only faintly now I see Him,
But a blessed day is coming,
When His glory shall be seen.
When are banished grief and pain;
When the crooked ways are straightened,
And the dark things shall be plain!
Face to face! oh, blissful moment!
Face to face to see and know;
Face to face with my Redeemer,
Jesus Christ, who loves me so.

songs.title: It May Be at Morn
lyrics: [C]It may be at morn, [F]when [C]the day is [G]awaking,
It may be at midday, it may be at twilight,
It may be, perchance, that the blackness of midnight
Will burst into light in the blaze of His glory,
O joy! O delight! should we go without dying,
No sickness, no sadness, no dread, and no crying,
Caught up through the clouds with our Lord into glory,

songs.title: There'll Be No Dark Valley
lyrics: [D]There'll be no dark valley when [A]Jesus comes,
There'll be no more sorrow when Jesus comes,
There'll be no more sorrow when Jesus comes,
There'll be a happy tomorrow when Jesus comes,
To gather His loved ones home.
There'll be songs of greeting when Jesus comes,
There'll be songs of greeting when Jesus comes,
There'll be songs of greeting when Jesus comes,
To gather His loved ones home.

songs.title: That Glorious Day Is Coming
lyrics: To meet Him in the air.
Will go to meet their Lord;
An earth both bright and glorious,
Then you, in that blest morning,
May meet Him in the sky!

songs.title: Wake, Awake for the Night Is Flying
lyrics: Wake, awake, for night is flying,
The watchmen on the heights are crying,
His chariot wheels are nearer rolling,
He comes; prepare, ye virgins wise.
Go forth, the Bridegroom meet; Alleluia!
Bear through the night your well-trimmed light,
Speed forth to join the marriage rite.
Her heart with deep delight is springing,
She wakes, she rises from her gloom;
In grace arrayed, by truth victorious;
Her Star is risen, her Light is come!
Our crown, and our reward! Alleluia!
We haste along, in pomp and song,
And gladsome join the marriage throng.
Lamb of God, the heavens adore Thee,
And men and angels sing before Thee,
With harp and cymbal's clearest tone.
By the pearly gates in wonder
We stand, and swell the voice of thunder,
That echoes round Thy dazzling throne.
We raise the song, we swell the throng,
To praise Thee ages all along.

songs.title: Lo! He Comes
lyrics: Every eye shall now behold Him
Those who set at nought and sold Him,
Pierced, and nailed Him to the tree,
When the solemn trump has sounded,
Heaven and earth shall flee away;
All who hate Him, must, confounded,
Hear the summons of that day-
Yea, amen! let all adore Thee,
Savior, take the power and glory,
O come quickly, O come quickly,
Claim the kingdom for Thine own!

songs.title: 'Tis Almost Time for the Lord to Come
lyrics: [C]'Tis almost time for the [F]Lord to come, I [C]hear the people [G]say;
[G]The [C]stars of [G7]heaven [Db]are [F]growing dim, It [C]must be the [G]breaking [G7]of the [C]day.
[C]O it must be the breaking of the day! O it [G]must be the breaking of the [C]day!
[C]The night is almost gone, The [F]day is coming [C]on;
The signs foretold in the sun and moon,
In earth and sea and sky,
The coming of the Master draweth nigh.
It must be time for the waiting church
With girded loins and burning lamps,
To look for the breaking of the day.
Go quickly out in the streets and lanes
And call the maimed, the halt, and blind,
To be ready for the breaking of the day.

songs.title: Jesus Is Coming Again
lyrics: [A]Lift up the trumpet, and [E]loud let it ring [A]Jesus is [B7]coming [E]again!
[A]Cheer up, ye pilgrims, be [E]joyful and [D]sing Jesus is [A]coming again!
Echo it, hilltops; proclaim it, ye plains
Coming in glory, the Lamb that was slain;
Heavings of earth, tell the vast, wondering throng
Tempests and whirlwinds, the anthem prolong;
Nations are angry--by this we do know
Knowledge increases; men run to and fro;

songs.title: We Have This Hope
lyrics: We are united in Jesus Christ our Lord.
We are united in His love.
Love for the waiting people of the world,
People who need our Savior's love.
Soon the heav'ns will open wide,
Christ will come to claim His bride,
We have this hope this faith, and God's great love,

songs.title: The King Shall Come
lyrics: The King shall come when morning dawns
When beauty gilds the eastern hills
Not as of old a little child,
To bear and fight and die,
But crowned with glory like the sun
O, brighter than the rising morn
And left the lonesome place of death,
O, brighter than that glorious morn
The day when Christ in splendor comes,
And we shall see His face.
The King shall come when morning dawns
Hail, Christ the Lord! Your people pray

songs.title: When the Roll Is Called Up Yonder
lyrics: [G]When the trumpet of the Lord shall sound and [C]time shall be no [G]more,
And the morning breaks, eternal bright and [D7]fair;
When the [G]saved of earth shall gather over [C]on the other [G]shore,
And the roll is called up [D7]yonder, I'll be [G]there.
[G]When the roll is called up yonder.
When the [D7]roll is called up yonder.
When the [G]roll is called up [D7]yonder I'll be [G]there.
[G]On that bright and cloudless morning, when the [C]dead in Christ shall [G]rise,
And the glory of His resurrection [D7]share;
When His [G]chosen ones shall gather to their [C]home beyond the [G]skies,
And the roll is called up [D7]yonder, I'll be [G]there.
[G]Let us labor for the Master from the [C]dawn till setting [G]sun,
Let us talk of all His wondrous love and [D7]care,
Then, when [G]all of life is over, and our [C]work on earth is [G]done,
And the roll is called up [D7]yonder, I'll be [G]there.

songs.title: The Church Has Waited Long
lyrics: And still in loneliness she waits,
How long, O Lord our God,
Wilt Thou not judge Thy suffering church,
Her sighs and tears and blood?
We long to hear Thy voice,
To see Thee face to face,
To share Thy crown and glory then,
As now we share Thy grace.
The curse, the sin, the stain,
And make this blighted world of ours

songs.title: When He Cometh
lyrics: [D]When He cometh, when He cometh [G]To [D]make up [A7]His [D]jewels,
He will gather, He will gather
All the pure ones, all the bright ones,

songs.title: When Jesus Comes in Glory
lyrics: When Jesus comes in glory, As Lord and King of kings,
O what a wondrous story The blessed Bible brings
His face will shine like sunlight, His head be white as snow,
His eyes like flaming firelight, His feet like brass aglow.
His voice like rushing waters Will reach with mighty sound
Into the deepest quarters Of all creation round;
And at this wondrous greeting The dead in Christ shall rise,
Their Lord and Savior meeting In glory in the skies.
And we who are believing And His appearing love,
Shall know we are receiving His glory from above;
His resurrection power Will raise us to the place
Where we that wondrous hour Shall see Him face to face.
O hasten Thine appearing, Thou bright and Morning Star!
Lord, may we soon be hearing The trumpet sound afar;
Thy people all are yearning To be Thy raptured bride,
And at Thine own returning Be caught up to Thy side.

songs.title: When He Comes
lyrics: When He comes, When He comes,
We shall see the Lord in glory
when He comes! As I read the gospel story,
We shall see the Lord in glory,
We shall see the Lord in glory when He comes!
With the alleluias ringing to the sky,
With the alleluias ringing to the sky,
As I read the gospel story,
We shall see the Lord in glory,
With the alleluias ringing to the sky!
When He comes, When He comes,
We shall hear the trumpet sounded,
when He comes! We shall hear the trumpet sounded,
See the Lord by saints surrounded,
We shall hear the trumpet sounded, when He comes!
With the alleluias ringing to the sky,
With the alleluias ringing to the sky,
We shall hear the trumpet sounded,
See the Lord by saints surrounded,
With the alleluias ringing to the sky!
When He comes, When He comes,
We shall all rise up to meet Him
when He comes! We shall all rise up to meet Him,
When He calls His own to greet Him
We shall all rise up to meet Him when He comes!
With the alleluias ringing to the sky,
With the alleluias ringing to the sky,
We shall all rise up to meet Him,
When He calls His own to greet Him,
With the alleluias ringing to the sky!

songs.title: Rejoice, the Lord Is King
lyrics: [C]Jesus, the Savior, reigns, The [F]God of [G7]truth and [G]love;
His [C]kingdom cannot fail, He [F]rules o'er [G7]earth and [G]heaven
[C]Rejoice in glorious hope! Our [F]Lord the [G7]judge shall [G]come,

songs.title: Hark! Ten Thousand Harps and Voices
lyrics: [D7]Nothing [G]from Thy love shall [D]sever [D7]Those whom [G]Thou hast [D7]made Thine [G]own;
[D7]Happy objects of Thy grace, [G]Destined to behold Thy face.
[D7]Then, with golden harps we'll sing, "[G]Glory, glory to our King!"

songs.title: Seek Ye First the Kingdom
lyrics: Seek ye first the kingdom, 'Tis your Father's will.
So the voice of Jesus bids us follow still.
Savior, we would hear Thee, Follow, find, and see;
And in life's adventure Thy disciples be.
As for hidden treasure, Or for matchless pearl,
When at last discovered, some will sell their all
So, when breaks the vision of that kingdom fair,
Ours shall be its riches and its beauty rare.
As the silent leaven works its secret way,
Or as grows the seed grain through the night and day;
Lord, so be the increase, peaceable but sure,
Of Thy word within us, And Thy kingdom's power.
As the tender seedling grows up tall and strong,
And the birds of heaven to its branches throng;
So shall all God's children, from the east and west,
Gather to His kingdom, In its shadow rest.
Humblest shall be greatest, poor in spirit reign;
Home shall come the childlike, born through Thee again
Eager hearts arrive there on the pilgrim's road,
Hail! the kingdom glorious of the living God!

songs.title: God Is Working His Purpose Out
lyrics: God is working His purpose out As year suceeds to year;
God is working His purpose out, And the time is drawing near;
Nearer and nearer draws the time, The time that shall surely be
When the earth shall be filled with the glory of God As the waters cover the sea.
From utmost east to utmost west, Where'er man's foot hath trod,
By the mouth of many messengers Goes forth the voice of God;
Give ear to me, ye confinents, Ye isles, give ear to me,
That the earth shall be filled with the glory of God As the waters cover the sea.
March we forth in the strength of God With the banner of Christ unfurled,
That the light of the glorious gospel of truth May shine throughout the world
Fight we the fight with sorrow and sin To set their captives free,
That the earth shall be filled with the glory of God As the waters cover the sea.
All we can do is nothing worth Unless God blesses the deed;
Vainly we hope for the harvest tide Till God gives life to teh seed;
Yet nearer and nearer draws the time, The time that shall surely be,
When the earth shall be filled with the glory of God As the waters cover the sea.

songs.title: Lift Up Your Heads
lyrics: Lift up your heads, ye mighty gates!
Behold the King of glory waits;
The King of kings is drawing near,
The Savior of the world is here.
The Lord is just, a helper tried;
Mercy is ever at His side;
O blest the land, the city blest,
Where Christ the Ruler is confessed!
O happy hearts and happy homes
To whom this King in triumph comes!
Fling wide the portals of your heart;
Make it a temple, set apart
From earthly use for heaven's employ,
Adorned with prayer, and love, and joy.
My heart to Thee; here, Lord, abide.
Let me Thy inner presence feel,
Thy grace and love in me reveal.

songs.title: A Hymn of Glory Let Us Sing
lyrics: A hymn of glory let us sing; New hymns thro'-out the world shall ring
Christ, by a road before untrod, Ascends unto the throne of God.
O Lord, our homeward pathway bend, That our unwearied hearts ascend.
Where, seated on Your Father's throne, You reign as King of kings alone.
Give us Your joy on earth, O Lord, In heav'n to be our great reward.
When throned with You forever, we Shall praise Your name eternally.
O risen Christ, ascended Lord, All praise to you let earth accord
You are, while endless ages run, With Father and with Spirit one.

songs.title: All Hail the Power of Jesus' Name
lyrics: [C7]Hail [F]Him who saves you by His grace, [C7]and [F]crown [C7]Him [Dm]Lord [G]of [C]all.
Hail [F]Him who saves you [C7]by His grace, [Dm]and [F]crown [Bb]Him [F]Lord of all.
To [F]Him all majesty ascribe, [Dm]and [F]crown [Bb]Him [F]Lord of all.

songs.title: All Glory, Laud, and Honor
lyrics: to thee, now [D]high [E]exalted, our melody we [A]raise.

songs.title: Blest Be the King
lyrics: Blest be the King whose coming Is in the name of God!
For Him let doors be opened, No hearts against Him barred!
Not robed in royal splendor, In power and pomp comes He;
But clad as are the poorest, Such His humility.
Blest be the King whose coming Is in the name of God!
By those who truly listen His voice is truly heard;
Pity the proud and haughty, Who have not learned to heed
The Christ who is the promise, Who has atonement made.
Blest be the King whose coming Is in the name of God!
He only to the humble Reveals the face of God.
All power is His, all glory!  All things are in His hand,
All ages and all peoples, 'Till time itself shall end.
Blest be the King whose coming Is in the name of God!
He offers to the burdened The rest and grace they need.
Gentle is He and humble!  And light his Yoke shall be,
For He would have us bear it, So He can made us free!

songs.title: At the Name of Jesus
lyrics: At His voice creation sprang at once to sight,
All the angel faces, All the hosts of light,
Thrones and dominations stars upon their way,
All the heavenly orders in their great array.
Humbled for a season, To receive a name
From the lips of sinners, Unto whom He came;
He is God the Savior, He is Christ the Lord,
Ever to be worshiped, Trusted and adored.
In your hearts enthrone Him There let Him subdue
All that is not holy, All that is not true;
Crown Him as your captain in temptation's hour,
Let His will enfold you in its light and power.
Surely, this Lord Jesus shall return again,
With His Father's glory, With His angel train;
For all wreaths of empire meet upon His brow,
And our hearts confess Him King of glory now.

songs.title: Christ, Whose Glory Fills the Skies
lyrics: Christ, whose glory fills the skies, Christ, the true, the only light,
Sun of Righteousness, arise, triumph o'er the shades of night;
Dayspring from on high, be near; Daystar, in my heart appear.
Dark and cheerless is the morn unaccompanied by thee;
joyless is the day's return, till thy mercy's beams I see;
till they inward light impart, cheer my eyes and warm my heart.
Visit then this soul of mine; pierce the gloom of sin and grief;
fill me, Radiancy divine, scatter all my unbelief;
more and more thyself display, shining to the perfect day.

songs.title: Christ Is the World's Light
lyrics: He and none other; born in our darkness,
If we have seen Him, we have seen the Father
He and none other; no one can serve Him
Who else unites us one in God the Father?
He and none other; sold once for silver,
He who redeems us reigns with God the Father.
God and none other; give God the glory,
Spirit, Son, and Father; give God the glory,

songs.title: Christ Is Made the Sure Foundation
lyrics: Christ is made the sure foundation, Christ, our head and cornerstone,
Chosen of the Lord and precious, Binding all the Church in one;
Holy Zion's help forever And our confidence alone.
To this temple where we call You, Come, O Lord of hosts, and stay;
Come, with all Your loving kindness, Hear Your people as they pray;
And Your fullest benediction Shed within these walls today.
Grant, we pray to all Your faithful All the gifts they ask to gain;
What they gain from You forever With the blessed to retain;
And hereafter in Your glory Evermore with You to reign.
Praise and honor to the Father, Praise and honor to the Son,
Praise and honor to the Spirit, Ever three and ever one
One in might and one in glory While unending ages run!

songs.title: I Love Thee
lyrics: I love Thee, I love Thee, I love Thee,my Lord;
I love Thee, my Savior, I love Thee, my God.
I love Thee, I love Thee, and that Thou dost know;
But how much I love Thee my actions will show.
I'm happy, I'm happy, O, wondrous account!
My joys are immortal, I stand on the mount!
I gaze on my treasure and long to be there,
With Jesus and angels, and kindred so dear.
O Jesus, my Savior, with Thee I am blest,
My life and salvation, my joy and my rest
Thy name be my theme, and Thy love be my song;
Thy grace shall inspire both my heart and my tongue.
O, who's like my Savior? He's Salem's bright King;
He smiles, and He loves me, and helps me to sing.
I'll praise Him, I'll praise Him, with notes loud and clear
While rivers of pleasure my spirit do cheer.

songs.title: In the Cross of Christ I Glory
lyrics: When the woes of life o'ertake me,
never shall the cross forsake me.
Lo! it glows with peace and joy.
When the sun of bliss is beaming
light and love upon my way,
from the cross the radiance streaming
adds more luster to the day.
Bane and blessing, pain and pleasure,
peace is there that knows no measure,
joys that through all time abide.

songs.title: How Sweet the Name!
lyrics: How sweet the name of Jesus sounds
It soothes his sorrows, heals his wounds,
It makes the wounded spirit whole,
Dear name, the rock on which I build,
My Lord, my life, my way, my end!
Weak is the effort of my heart,
But when I see Thee as Thou art,
I'll praise Thee as I ought.

songs.title: Jesus, Priceless Treasure
lyrics: Jesus, priceless Treasure, Source of purest pleasure, Truest Friend to me
Ah! how long I've panted, And my heart has fainted, thirsting, Lord, for Thee.
Thine I am, O spotless Lamb, I will suffer naught to hide Thee,
In Thine arms I rest me; foes who would molest me Cannot reach me here.
Though the earth be shaking, Every heart be quaking, Jesus calms our fear.
Sin and hell in conflict fell, With their bitter storms assail me,
Hence, all thought of sadness! For the Lord of gladness, Jesus, enters in.
Those who love the Father, Though the storms may gather, still have peace within;
Yea, whatever we here must bear, Still in Thee lies purest pleasure,

songs.title: Fairest Lord Jesus
lyrics: [D]Fair are the meadows, fairer still the [G]woodlands,
[D]Fair is the sunshine, fairer still the [G]moonlight,

songs.title: Jesus, the Very Thought of Thee
Jesus, Thou Joy of Loving Hearts
lyrics: Jesus, Thou joy of loving hearts!
Thou fount of life! Thou light of men!
From the best bliss that earth imparts,
We turn unfilled to Thee again.
Thy truth unchanged has ever stood;
Thou savest those that on Thee call;
To them that seek Thee Thou art good,
To them that find Thee, all in all.
We taste Thee, O Thou living Bread,
And long to feast upon Thee still;
We drink of Thee, the Fountainhead,
And thirst our souls from Thee to fill!
Our restless spirits yearn for Thee,
Where-e'r our changeful lot is cast;
Glad, when Thy gracious smile we see,
Blest, when our faith can hold Thee fast.
O Jesus, ever with us stay;
Make all our moments calm and bright;
Chase the dark night of sin away,
Shed o'r the world Thy holy light!

songs.title: King of Glory, King of Peace
lyrics: King of glory, King of peace, I will love Thee;
And that love may never cease, I will move Thee.
Thou hast granted my request, Thou hast heard me;
Thou didst note my working breast, Thou hast spared me.
Wherefore with my utmost art I will sing Thee,
And the cream of all my heart I will bring Thee.
Though my sins against me cried, Thou didst clear me;
And alone, when they replied, Thou didst hear me.
Seven whole days, not one in seven, I will praise Thee;
In my heart, though not in heav'n I can raise Thee.
Small it is, in this poor sort to enroll Thee
Ev'n eternity's too short to extol Thee.

songs.title: My Song Shall Be of Jesus
lyrics: My song shall be of Jesus;
He fills my cup with blessings,
And tunes my heart to praise.
My song shall be of Jesus,
And bought me with His blood.
My song shall be of Jesus
I call to mind His goodness
My song shall be of Jesus,
I'll sing the grace that saves me,
And keeps me at His side.
My song shall be of Jesus
And when my soul shall enter
A song of praise to Jesus

songs.title: More About Jesus
lyrics: [G]More about Jesus, I would know, [D]More of His grace to [G]others show;
[G]More of His saving fullness see, [D7]More of His love who died for [G]me.
[G]More of His saving fullness see, [D7]More of His love who died for [G]me.
More about Jesus, let me learn,
More of His holy will discern;
Spirit of God, my teacher be,
Showing the things of Christ to me.
More about Jesus, in His word,
Hearing His voice in every line,
More about Jesus, on His throne,
Riches in glory all His own;
More of His kingdom's sure increase,
More of His coming, Prince of Peace.

songs.title: Worthy, Worthy Is the Lamb
lyrics: Now the power of sin consume;
Thus may we each moment feel,
Love Him, serve Him, praise Him still,
Till we all on Zion's hill

songs.title: Come, My Way
lyrics: Come, my Way, my Truth, my Life
Such a Way as gives us breath,
Such a Truth as ends all strife,
Such a life as killeth death.
Come, my Light, my Feast, my Strength
Such a Light as shows a feast,
Such a Feast as mends in length,
Such a Strength as makes His guest.
Come, my Joy, my Love, my Heart
Such a joy as none can move,
Such a Love as none can part,
Such a Heart as joys in love.

songs.title: O, How I Love Jesus
lyrics: [G]There is a Name I love to hear, I [D]love to sing its [G]worth;
[G]It sounds like music in my ears, The [Am]sweetest [G]Name [D7]on [G]earth.
[G]O how I love Jesus, [D]O how I love [G]Jesus,
There [G]is a name I love to hear, I [D]love to sing its [G]worth[D];
It [G]sounds like music [Em]in my ear, The [Am]sweetest [D7]name on [G]earth.
[G]Oh, how I love Jesus, [D]Oh, how I love [G]Jesus,
It tells me of a Savior's love, Who died to set me free;
It tells me of a Savior's blood, The sinners' perfect plea.
It tells of one whose loving heart Can feel my deepest woe;
Who in each sorrow bears A part that none can bear below.

songs.title: Praise Him! Praise Him!
lyrics: [G]Praise Him! Praise Him! [C]Tell of His excellent [G]greatness.
Praise Him! Praise Him! Jesus, our blessed Redeemer!
For our sins He suffered, and bled, and died.
He our Rock, our hope of eternal salvation,
Hail Him! hail Him! Jesus the Crucified.
Sound His praises! Jesus who bore our sorrows,
Love unbounded, wonderful, deep and strong.
Praise Him! Praise Him! Jesus, our blessed Redeemer!
Heavenly portals loud with hosannas ring!
Jesus, Savior, reigneth forever and ever.
Crown Him! Crown Him! Prophet, and Priest, and King!
Christ is coming! over the world victorious,
Power and glory unto the Lord belong.

songs.title: O for a Thousand Tongues to Sing
lyrics: My gracious Master and my God,
to spread through all the earth abroad
Jesus! the name that charms our fears,
He breaks the power of canceled sin,
his blood can make the foulest clean;
He speaks, and listening to his voice,
Hear him, ye deaf; his praise, ye dumb,
ye blind, behold your savior come,
and leap, ye lame, for joy.

songs.title: He Lives
lyrics: I [G]serve a risen Savior, He's in the world today;
I see His hand of mercy, I hear His voice of cheer
And [A]just the time I need Him He's always [D]near.
He [D7]walks with me and [G]talks with me [A7]along life's narrow [D7]way.
You [E7]ask me how I [A7]know He lives? He [G]lives [D7]within my [G]heart.
I [G]serve a risen saviour; [C]He's [G]in the world today.
I [B]know that [Em]He is living [A7]whatever man may [D7]say.
I [G]see His hand of mercy, I hear His voice of cheer
And [A]just the time I [A7]need Him, [D]He's always there.
He [D]walks with [G]me and He talks with me,
You [E7]ask me how I [A]know He lives; He [G]lives [D]within my [G]heart
In all the world around me I see His loving care,
And tho' my heart grows weary I never will despair;
I know that He is leading thru all the stormy blast,
The day of His appearing will come at last.
Rejoice, rejoice, O Christian, lift up your voice and sing,
Eternal hallelujahs to Jesus Christ the King!
The hope of all who seek Him, the help of all who find,
None other is so loving, so good and kind.

songs.title: Come, Let Us Sing
lyrics: Come, let us sing the song of songs-
The angels first began the strain-
The homage which to Christ belongs
"Worthy the Lamb, for He was slain!"
Slain to redeem us by His blood,
To cleanse from every sinful stain,
And make us kings and priests to God
"Worthy the Lamb, for He was slain!"
To Him who suffered on the tree,
Our souls, at His soul's price, to gain,
Blessing, and praise, and glory be
"Worthy the Lamb, for He was slain!"
To Him, enthroned by filial right
All power in heaven and earth proclaim,
"Worthy the Lamb, for He was slain!"
Long as we live, and when we die,
And while in heaven with Him we reign,
This song our song of songs shall be
"Worthy the Lamb, for He was slain!"

songs.title: There's No Other Name Like Jesus
lyrics: [F]There's no other name like Jesus, 'Tis the [C7]dearest name we [F]know,
[F]'Tis the angel's joy in heaven, 'Tis the [C7]Christian's joy [F]below.
[F]Sweet name, (sweet name) dear name, (dear name) There's no [C7]other name like [F]Jesus;
[F]Sweet name, (sweet name) dear name, (dear name) There's no [C7]other name like [F]Jesus.
There's no other name like Jesus
When the heart with grief is sad,
There's no other name like Jesus
When the heart is free and glad.
'Tis the hope that I shall see Him
'Tis the hope to hear His welcome
If He wills that I should labor
In His vineyard day by day,
Blesses all I do or say.
If He wills that death's cold finger
Is my dying trust and stay.

songs.title: The Great Physician Now is Near
lyrics: Your many sins are all forgiven,
Oh! hear the voice of Jesus;
Go on your way in peace to heaven,
And wear a crown with Jesus.
All glory to the dying Lamb!
I love the blessed Savior's name,
I love the name of Jesus.
His name dispels my guilt and fear,
Oh! how my soul delights to hear

songs.title: I Cannot Tell Why
lyrics: I cannot tell how silently He suffered
As with His peace He graced this place of tears,
Nor how His heart upon the cross was broken,
The crown of pain to three and thirty years.
But this I know He heals the broken hearted
And stays our sin and calms our lurking fear,
And lifts the burden from the heavy laden;
For still the Savior, Savior of the world, is here.
I cannot tell how He will win the nations,
How He will claim His earthly heritage,
How satisfy the needs and aspirations
Of east and west, of sinner and of sage.
But this I know all flesh shall see His glory,
And He shall reap the harvest He has sown,
And some glad day His sun will shine in splendor
When He the Savior, Savior of the world, is known.
I cannot tell how all the lands shall worship,
When at His bidding every storm is stilled,
Or who can say how great the jubilation
When all our hearts with love for Him are filled.
But this I know the skies shall sound His praises,
Ten thousand thousand human voices sing,
And earth to heaven, and heaven to earth will answer,
At last the Savior, Savior of the world, is King!

songs.title: Ye Servants of God
lyrics: God ruleth on high, almighty to save,
and still he is nigh, his presence we have;
the great congregation his triumph shall sing,
ascribing salvation to Jesus, our King.
"Salvation to God, who sits on the throne!"
Let all cry aloud and honor the Son;
the praises of Jesus the angels proclaim,
fall down on their faces and worship the Lamb.
Then let us adore and give him his right,
all glory and power, all wisdom and might;
all honor and blessing with angels above,
and thanks never ceasing and infinite love.

songs.title: Come Down, O Love Divine
lyrics: Come down, O Love divine, seek thou this soul of mine
and visit it with thine own ardor glowing;
O Comforter, draw near, within my heart appear,
and kindle it, thy holy flame bestowing.
O let it freely burn, till earthly passions turn
to dust and ashes in its heat consuming;
and let thy glorious light shine ever on my sight,
and clothe me round, the while my path illuming.
Let holy charity Mine outward vesture be,
And lowliness become my inner clothing;
True lowliness of heart which takes the humbler part,
And o'er its own shortcomings weeps with loathing.
And so the yearning strong with which the soul will long
shall far outpass the power of human telling;
for none can guess its grace, till Love create a place
wherein the Holy Spirit makes a dwelling.

songs.title: Baptize Us Anew
lyrics: [G]Baptize us anew With [C]power from on high,
We praise Thee, we bless Thee, dear Lamb that was slain
We laud and adore Thee, Amen and Amen.
O wash us and cleanse us From sin's guilty stain.
O heavenly Dove, Descend from on high!
We plead Thy rich blessing; In mercy draw nigh.
O list the glad voice! From heaven it came
Thou art My beloved, Well pleased I am.

songs.title: Draw Us in the Spirit's Tether
lyrics: Draw us in the Spirit's tether,
For when humbly in Thy name,
Two or three are met together,
Thou art in the midst of them;
Touch we now Thy garment's hem.
As the brethren used to gather
In the name of Christ to sup,
Then with thanks to God the Father
Break the bread and bless the cup,
So knit Thou our friendship up
All our meals and all our living

songs.title: Hover O'er Me, Holy Spirit
lyrics: [F]Hover [C7]o'er me, [F]Holy Spirit, Bathe my trembling heart and [C]brow;
[F]Fill me [C7]with Thy [F]hallowed presence, Come, O come and [C7]fill me [F]now.
[C]Fill me now, [F]fill me now, [Bb]Jesus, [F]come and fill me [C]now.
[F]Fill me [C7]with Thy [F]hallowed presence, Come, O come and [C7]fill me [F]now.
Thou canst fill me, gracious Spirit,
Though I cannot tell Thee how;
But I need Thee, greatly need Thee;
Come, O come and fill me now.
I am weakness, full of weakness;
At Thy sacred feet I bow;
Fill with love, and fill me now.
Cleanse and comfort, bless and save me;
Bathe, O, bathe my heart and brow;

songs.title: The Spirit of the Lord Revealed
lyrics: The prophets passed; at length there came
The Word incarnate, to whose name
As man with man, revealed at last
That we in this our day, may seek
To us the word of life impart,
Give us the quiet, humble heart

songs.title: Fire of God, Thou Sacred Flame
lyrics: Fire of God, Thou sacred flame,
Let Thy heat my soul refine
Till it glows with love divine.
Breath of God, that swept in power
Holy Breath, be Thou in me
Strength of God, Thy might within
All the gateways of my heart.
Truth of God, Thy piercing rays
May the light that shames my sin
Guide me holier paths to win.
Love of God, Thy grace profound
Come, my heart's own guest to be,

songs.title: O for That Flame of Living Fire
lyrics: Where is that spirit, Lord, which dwelt
In Abram's breast, and sealed Him Thine?
Which made Paul's heart with sorrow melt,
That spirit which from age to age
Proclaimed Thy love, and taught Thy ways?
And breathed in David's hallowed lays?
Is not Thy grace as mighty now
As when Elijah felt its power?
When glory beamed from Moses' brow,
Or Job endured the trying hour?
Renew Thy work, Thy grace restore;
And while to Thee our hearts we raise,
On us Thy Holy Spirit pour.

songs.title: Breathe on Me, Breath of God
lyrics: Breathe on me, breath of God,
That I may love what Thou dost love,
And do what Thou wouldst do.
Breathe on me, breath of God,
Until with Thee I will one will,
Breathe on me, breath of God,
Until this earthly part of me
Breathe on me, breath of God,
And live with Thee the perfect life

songs.title: Spirit of God
lyrics: Spirit of God, descend upon my heart;
wean it from earth; through all its pulses move;
stoop to my weakness, mighty as thou art,
and make me love thee as I ought to love.
I ask no dream, no prophet ecstasies,
no sudden rending of the veil of clay,
no angel visitant, no opening skies;
but take the dimness of my soul away.
Hast thou not bid me love thee, God and King?
All, all thine own, soul, heart and strength and mind.
I see thy cross; there teach my heart to cling.
O let me seek thee, and O let me find.
Teach me to feel that thou art always nigh;
teach me the struggles of the soul to bear.
To check the rising doubt, the rebel sigh,
teach me the patience of unanswered prayer.
Teach me to love thee as thine angels love,
one holy passion filling all my frame;
the kindling of the heaven-descended Dove,
my heart an altar, and thy love the flame.

songs.title: Spirit Divine
lyrics: And make this house Thy home;
Descend with all Thy gracious powers,
Come as the light; to us reveal
And lead us in those paths of life
Come as the fire, and purge our hearts
Let our whole soul an off'ring be
Come as the dove, and spread Thy wings,
And let Thy church on earth become

songs.title: Holy Spirit, Light Divine
lyrics: Shine upon this heart of mine,
Chase the shades of night away,
Cleanse this guilty heart of mine;
Cheer this saddened heart of mine,
Dwell within this heart of mine,

songs.title: Come, Holy Spirit
lyrics: O raise our thoughts from things below,
Then shall we with fresh courage go
Awake our souls to joyful songs;
Till praise employs our thankful tongues,
Father, we would no longer live
To Thee our thankful love we give,
For Thine to us is great.
Come, shed abroad a Savior's love,

songs.title: O Holy Dove of God Descending
lyrics: O holy Wind of God now blowing,
You are the seed that God us sowing.
You are the life that starts us growing
O holy Rain of God now falling,
You make the Word of God enthralling,
You are that inner voice now calling
O holy Flame of God now burning,
You are the power of Christ returning.
You are the answer to our yearning

songs.title: Break Thou the Bread of Life
lyrics: Bless thou the truth, dear Lord, to me, to me,
as thou didst bless the bread by Galilee;
then shall all bondage cease, all fetters fall;
and I shall find my peace, my all in all.
Thou art the bread of life, O Lord, to me;
Thy holy Word the truth That saveth me;
Give me to eat and live With Thee above;
Teach me to love Thy truth, For Thou art love.
Spirit and life are they, Words Thou dost speak;
I hasten to obey, But I am weak;
Thou art my only help, Thou art my life;
Heeding Thy holy Word I win the strife.

songs.title: Give Me the Bible
lyrics: [C]Since Jesus came to [D]seek and save the [G]lost.
[G]Thy light shall guide me in the [A]narrow [D]way;
the path of peace can show.

songs.title: Lord, I Have Made Thy Word My Choice
lyrics: Lord, I have made Thy word my choice,
There shall my noblest powers rejoice,
I'll read the histories of Thy love,
And keep Thy laws in sight;
While through Thy promises I rove,
In this broad land of wealth unknown,
Seeds of immortal bliss are sown,
The best relief that mourners have,
Our fairest hope beyond the grave,

songs.title: O Word of God Incarnate
lyrics: O Light of our dark sky
we praise you for the radiance
shines on from age to age.
The church from her dear Master
and still that light is lifted
o'er all the earth to shine.
where gems of truth are stored;
It is the chart and compass
mid mists and rocks and quicksands,
Still guides, O Christ, to Thee.
O make Thy church, dear Savior,
your true light as of old.
by this their path to trace,
they see Thee face to face.

songs.title: O God of Light
lyrics: O God of light, Your Word, a lamp unfailing,
Shall pierce the darkness of our earthbound way
And show your grace, Your plan for us unveiling,
And guide our footsteps to the perfect day.
From days of old,through blind and willful ages,
Though we rebelled, You gently sought again,
And spoke through saints, apostles, prophets, sages,
Who wrote with eager or reluctant pen.
Undimmed by time,those words are still revealing
To sinful hearts Your justice and Your grace;
And questing mortals longing for Your healing,
See Your compassion in the Savior's face.
To all the world Your summons You are sending,
Through all the earth, to every land and race,
That myriad tongues, in one great anthem blending,
May praise and celebrate Your gift of grace.

songs.title: Thanks to God
lyrics: Thanks to God whose Word was spoken
In the deed that made the earth.
His the voice that called a nation;
His the fires that tried her worth.
Praise Him for His open Word.
Thanks to God whose Word incarnate
Deeds and words and death and rising
Tell the grace in heaven's plan.
Praise Him for His open Word.
Thanks to God whose Word is answered
Here we drink of joy unmeasured,
Life redeemed from death and sin.
Praise Him for His open Word.

songs.title: For Your Holy Book We Thank You
lyrics: For Your holy book we thank You,
And for all who served You well,
That its pages might forth tell
Your strong love and tender care
For Your holy book we thank You,
And for those who work today,
That the people of all nations,
Know Your love and tender care
For Your holy book we thank You,
May its message be our guide,
Of the laws it will provide
And Your love and tender care
For Your holy book we thank You,
May its message in our hearts
Lead us now to see in Jesus
All the grace Your word imparts
All Your love and tender care

songs.title: Lord Jesus, Once You Spoke to Men
lyrics: Lord Jesus, once You spoke to men
Upon the mountain and the plain,
O help us listen now as then
And wonder at Your words again.
We all have secret fears to face,
Our minds and motives to amend.
We seek Your truth, we need Your grace,
Our living Lord and present friend.
The gospel speaks; and we receive
Your light, Your love, Your own command.
O help us live what we believe,
In daily word of heart and hand.

songs.title: Only Trust Him
lyrics: [G]Come, every soul by sin oppressed, There's mercy with the [D]Lord,
And [G]He will surely [C]give you rest, By [G]trusting in [D7]His [G]word.
[G]Only trust Him, [C]only trust [G]Him, Only trust Him [D]now;
[G]He will save you, [C]He will save you, [G]He will save [D7]you [G]now.
For Jesus shed his precious blood
Plunge now into the crimson flood
Yes, Jesus is the truth, the way,
Come, then, and join this holy band,
To dwell in that celestial land,

songs.title: Come, Ye Sinners
lyrics: Come, ye sinners poor and needy,
Weak and wounded, sick and sore;
Jesus ready stands to save you,
Full of pity, love, and power.
I will arise and go to Jesus,
He will embrace me in His arms;
In the arms of my dear Savior,
O there are ten thousand charms.
Come. ye thirsty, come, and welcome,
Every grace that brings you nigh.
Let not conscience make you linger,
Is to feel your need of Him.
Pleads the merit of His blood;

songs.title: I Gave My Life for Thee
lyrics: [G]I [D]gave, I gave My [G]life [C]for [G]thee, What [D]hast thou [D7]given for [G]Me?
[G]I [D]gave, I gave My [C]life for [G]thee, What [D]hast thou [D7]given for [G]Me?
I left, I left it all for thee,
Hast thou left aught for Me?
I left, I left it all for thee,
Hast thou left aught for Me?
more than thy tongue can tell,
I've borne, I've borne it all for thee,
What hast thou borne for Me?
I've borne, I've borne it all for thee,
What hast thou borne for Me?

songs.title: I Hear Thy Welcome Voice
lyrics: [C]I hear Thy welcome voice, That [G]calls me, Lord, to [C]Thee;
[C]For cleansing in Thy precious blood, That [G]flowed on [C]Calvary.
[C]Wash me, cleanse me, in the blood That [G7]flowed on [C]Calvary.
Thou dost my vileness fully cleanse,
To perfect hope, and peace, and trust,
All hail! the gift of Christ, our Lord,

songs.title: O Jesus, Thou Art Standing
lyrics: his Name and sign who bear,
O shame, thrice shame upon us,
and lo, that hand is scarred,
and tears thy face have marred
O sin that hath no equal,
so fast to bar the gate!
and will you treat me so?"
O Lord, with shame and sorrow

songs.title: For You I Am Praying
lyrics: I have a Father; to me He has given
A hope for eternity, blessed and true;
And soon He will call to meet Him in heaven,
But oh that He'd let me bring you with me, too!
I have a robe; 'tis resplendent in whiteness,
Awaiting in glory my wondering view;
Oh, when I receive it, all shining in brightness,
Dear friend, could I see you receiving one, too!
When Jesus has found you, tell others the story,
That my loving Savior is your Savior, too;
Then pray that your Savior will bring them to glory,
And prayer will be answered-'twas answered for you!

songs.title: Jesus Calls Us
lyrics: Jesus calls us from the worship
of the vain world's golden store,
from each idol that would keep us,
In our joys and in our sorrows,
days of toil and hours of ease,
still he calls, in cares and pleasures,
Jesus calls us! By thy mercies,
Savior, may we hear thy call,
give our hearts to thine obedience,
serve and love thee best of all.

songs.title: Wonderful Words of Life
lyrics: [F]Sing them over [C7]again to me, wonderful words of [F]life,
[F]Let me more of their [C7]beauty see, wonderful words of [F]life;
[F]Words of life and [Bb]beauty teach me faith and duty.
[F]Christ, the blessed One, [C]gives to all wonderful words of [F]life;
[F]Sinner, list to the [C]loving call, wonderful words of [F]life;
All so freely [Bb]given, wooing us to heaven.
[F]Sweetly echo the [C]Gospel call, wonderful words of [F]life;
[F]Offer pardon and [C]peace to all, wonderful words of [F]life;

songs.title: Softly and Tenderly
lyrics: [G]At the heart's portals He's [C]waiting and watching,
Why should we tarry when Jesus is pleading,
pleading for you and for me?
Why should we linger and heed not his mercies,
mercies for you and for me?
Think of the wonderful love he has promised,
promised for you and for me!
Though we have sinned, he has mercy and pardon,
pardon for you and for me.

songs.title: I Am Going to Calvary
lyrics: If I wear a thorny crown,
If the soldiers knock Me down
Can I really be a king?
When I go along the road,
I shall lift a heavy load.
I will carry a cross for you.
You will learn to carry it too
You will learn to carry it too
I am going to stretch My hands,
Reaching out to all the lands.
Can I really be a king?

songs.title: The Savior Is Waiting
lyrics: You'll find His arms open wide.
Receive Him, and all of your darkness will end

songs.title: Turn Your Eyes Upon Jesus
lyrics: He passed, and we follow Him there;
Over us sin no more hath dominion--
For more than conquerors we are!
His Word shall not fail you--He promised;
Believe Him, and all will be well
Then go to a world that is dying,

songs.title: We Have Not Known Thee
lyrics: We have not known Thee as we ought,
Nor learned Thy wisdom, grace, and power;
The things of earth have filed our thoughts,
And trifles of the passing hour.
Lord, give us light Thy truth to see,
And make us wise in knowing Thee.
We have not feared Thee as we ought,
Nor bowed beneath Thine awful eye,
Nor guarded deed, and word, and thought,
Lord, give us faith to know Thee near,
And grant the grace of holy fear.
We have not loved Thee as we ought,
Nor cared that we are loved by Thee;
Thy presence we have coldly sought,
And feebly longed Thy face to see.
Lord, give a pure and loving heart
To feel and own the love Thou art.
We have not served Thee as we ought;
The work with little fervor wrought,
The battles lost, or scarcely won!
Lord, give the zeal, and give the might,
For Thee to toil, for Thee to fight.
When shall we know Thee as we ought,
And fear, and love, and serve aright!
When shall we, out of trial brought,
Be perfect in the land of light!
Lord, may we day by day prepare
To see Thy face, and serve Thee there.

songs.title: Jesus, I Come
lyrics: Out of my shameful failure and loss,
Jesus, I come, Jesus, I come;
Into the glorious gain of Thy cross,
Out of earth's sorrows into Thy balm,
Out of life's storms and into Thy calm,
Out of distress to jubilant psalm,
Out of unrest and arrogant pride,
Jesus, I come, Jesus, I come;
Into Thy blessed will to abide,
Out of myself to dwell in Thy love,
Out of despair into raptures above,
Upward for aye on wings like a dove,
Out of the fear and dread of the tomb,
Jesus, I come, Jesus, I come;
Into the joy and light of Thy home,
Out of the depths of ruin untold,
Into the peace of Thy sheltering fold,
Ever Thy glorious face to behold,

songs.title: Heavenly Father, Bless Us Now
lyrics: At the cross of Christ we bow;
Take our guilt and grief away;
Hear and heal us now, we pray.
Now, O Lord, this very hour,
Send Thy grace and show Thy power;
While we rest upon Thy word,
Come, and bless us now, O Lord!
Mercy now, O Lord, we plead
In this hour of utter need;
Rising o'er us like the sun,
Light and life art Thou within

songs.title: Power in the Blood
lyrics: [A]Would you be free from the [D]burden of [A]sin?
There's [E]pow'r in the blood, [A]pow'r in the blood;
[A]Would you be free from your [D]passion and [A]pride?
There's [E]pow'r in the blood, [A]pow'r in the blood;
There's [E]pow'r in the blood, [A]pow'r in the blood;

songs.title: Chief of Sinners
lyrics: O the height of Jesus' love!
Found me when I sought Him not!
Chief of sinners though I be,
Christ is all in all to me;
All my wants to Him are known,
All my sorrows are His own;
Safe with Him from earthly strife,

songs.title: Lord, I'm Coming Home
lyrics: I've wasted many precious years, Now I'm coming home;
I now repent with bitter tears; Lord, I'm coming home.
I'm tired of sin and straying Lord, Now I'm coming home;
I'll trust thy love belive thy word; Lord, I'm coming home.
My only hope, my only plea, Now I'm coming home;
That Jesus died, and died for me; Lord, I'm coming home.
I need His cleansing blood I know, Now I'm coming home;
O wash me whiter than the snow; Lord, I'm coming home.

songs.title: God Be Merciful to Me
lyrics: On Thy grace I rest my plea;
Wash me, make me pure within,
Cleanse, O cleanse me from my sin,
Wash me, make me pure within,
Cleanse, O cleanse me from my sin.
I am evil, born in sin;
Teach Thy wisdom to my heart;
Make me pure, Thy grace bestow,
Wash me whiter than the snow,
Make me pure, Thy grace bestow,
Wash me whiter than the snow.
Make my spirit right and true;
Cast me not away from Thee,
Let Thy Spirit dwell in me;
Sinners then shall learn from me
And return, O God, to Thee;
And my tongue shall sing Thy love;
Touch my silent lips, O Lord,
And my mouth shall praise accord,
Touch my silent lips, O Lord,
And my mouth shall praise accord.

songs.title: I Lay My Sins on Jesus
lyrics: I bring my guilt to Jesus,
White in His blood most precious,
I lay my wants on Jesus,
I long to be like Jesus,
I long to be like Jesus,
I long to be with Jesus
To sing with them His praises,

songs.title: Forgive Our Sins as We Forgive
lyrics: You taught us, Lord, to pray;
But You alone can grant us grace
To live the words we say.
How can Your pardon reach and bless
That broods on wrongs and will not let
In blazing light Your cross reveals
How trifling others' debts to us;
How great our debt to You!
Lord, cleanse the depths within our souls
Our lives will spread Your peace.

songs.title: Rock of Ages
lyrics: Not the labor of my hands
Could my zeal no respite know,
All for sin could not atone;
Thou must save, and Thou alone.
Victor o'er the last of foes,
When I soar to worlds unknown,
And behold Thee on Thy throne,
Rock of Ages, cleft for me,
Let me hide myself in Thee.

songs.title: Deeper Yet
lyrics: [A]In the blood from the cross, [E]I have been washed from [A]sin;
[A]But to be free from dross, [Bm]Still I would [E7]enter [A]in.
Day by day, hour by hour,
But for more of His power,
Near to Christ I would live,
What I ask He will give;
So then with faith I pray.
Now I have peace, sweet peace,
While in this world of sin;
But to pray I'll not cease

songs.title: Beneath the Cross of Jesus
lyrics: From the [G7]burning of the [C]noontide heat, [F]and the [C]burden [G7]of the [C]day.

songs.title: Faith of Our Fathers
lyrics: Our fathers, chained in prisons dark,
Were still in heart and conscience free
How sweet would be their children's fate.
If they, like them, could die for thee!
Faith of our fathers, we will love
Both friend and foe in all our strife;
And preach Thee, too, as love knows how
By kindly words and virtuous life.

songs.title: Give Me Jesus
lyrics: Just about the break of day,
Just about the break of day,
Just about the break of day,
Oh, when I come to die,
Oh, when I come to die,
Oh, when I come to die,

songs.title: Draw Me Nearer
lyrics: [G]I am Thine, [D7]O Lord, I have heard [G]thy voice,
But I long [D7]to rise in the arms [G]of faith
Consecrate me now to thy service, Lord,
by the power of grace divine;
let my soul look up with a steadfast hope,
and my will be lost in thine.
O the pure delight of a single hour
that before thy throne I spend,
when I kneel in prayer, and with thee, my God,
I commune as friend with friend!

songs.title: I Am Coming to the Cross
lyrics: [F]I am coming [C7]to the [F]cross; I am poor and weak and [C]blind;
[F]I am trusting, [C7]Lord, in [F]Thee. O thou Lamb of [C]Calvary;

songs.title: Wholly Thine
lyrics: [G]I would do Thy will, O Lord, [D7]not [G]mine; [D7]Help [Em]me, [G]help [D7]me [G]now.
What is worldly pleasure, wealth or fame,
I will leave them all for Thy dear Name,
As I cast earth's transient joys behind,
Come Thou near, come Thou near;
In Thy presence all in all I find,

songs.title: I Would Draw Nearer to Jesus
lyrics: [A]I would draw [E7]nearer to [A]Jesus, [E7]In His sweet presence [A]abide,
[Db7]Constantly trying to [F#m]serve Him, [B]Safe and [B7]secure at His [E]side.
[A]I would draw [Db]nearer to [D]Jesus, [B7]I would draw nearer to [E7]Him;
I would draw nearer to Jesus, Nothing withholding from Him,
Knowing He loves to be gracious, I would draw nearer to Him.
I would draw nearer to Jesus, I would draw nearer to Him;
Fully surrendered each moment, I would draw nearer to Him.
I would draw nearer to Jesus, Seeking Hi strength to be true,
Willing to tell of His goodness, Gladly His blest will to do.
I would draw nearer to Jesus, I would draw nearer to Him;
Fully surrendered each moment, I would draw nearer to Him.

songs.title: I Would Be Like Jesus
lyrics: [G]Earthly [Gdim]pleasures [G]vainly call me; I would be like [Am7]Jesus;
[G]Be like [C]Jesus, [A7]this my song, [D]In the [D7]home and [G]in the throng;
That my soul may serve Him better,
All the way from earth to glory,
Telling o'er and o'er the story,
That in Heaven He may meet me,
That His words "Well done" may greet me,

songs.title: Near the Cross
lyrics: Near the cross, a trembling soul,
there the bright and morning star
Near the cross! O Lamb of God,
help me walk from day to day
Near the cross I'll watch and wait,
till I reach the golden strand

songs.title: Just as I Am
lyrics: Just as I am, without one plea,
But that Thy blood was shed for me,
And that Thou bidst me come to Thee,
O Lamb of God, I come, I come.
Just as I am, and waiting not
To rid my soul of one dark blot,
To Thee whose blood can cleanse each spot,
O Lamb of God, I come, I come.
Just as I am, though tossed about
With many a conflict, many a doubt,
O Lamb of God, I come, I come.
Just as I am, poor, wretched, blind;
Sight, riches, healing of the mind,
Yea, all I need in Thee to find,
O Lamb of God, I come, I come.
Just as I am, Thou wilt receive,
O Lamb of God, I come, I come.
Just as I am, Thy love I own
Now, to be Thine, and Thine alone,
O Lamb of God, I come, I come.

songs.title: Just as I Am
lyrics: [D]And that Thou bidst me [G]come to Thee,

songs.title: O for a Closer Walk!
lyrics: I hate the sins that made Thee mourn
And drove Thee from my breast.
What peaceful hours I once enjoyed!
But they have left an aching void
The dearest idol I have known,
Help me to tear it from Thy throne,

songs.title: Live Out Thy Life Within Me
lyrics: The temple has been yielded, And purified of sin;
Let Thy Shekinah glory Now shine forth from within,
And all the earth keep silence, The body henceforth be
Thy silent, gentle servant, Moved only as by Thee.
Its members every moment Held subject to Thy call,
Ready to have Thee use them, Or not be used at all;
Held without restless longing, Or strain, or stress, or fret
Or chafings at Thy dealings, Or thoughts of vain regret.
But restful, calm, and pliant, From bend and bias free,
Awaiting Thy decision, When Thou hast need of me.
Live out Thy life within me, O Jesus, King of kings!
Be Thou the glorious answer To all my questionings.

songs.title: Lead Me to Calvary
lyrics: [C]King of my life, I [F]crown Thee [C]now, Thine shall the glory [G]be;
[C]Lest I forget Thy [F]thorn crowned [C]brow, Lead me to [G7]Calvary.
[Am]Lest I [E7]forget Thy [F]love for [C]me, Lead me to [G7]Calvary.
[Am]Lest I [E7]forget Thy [F]love for [C]me, Lead me to [G7]Calvary.
Show me the tomb where Thou wast laid,
Angels in robes of light arrayed
Let me like Mary, through the gloom,
Come with a gift to Thee;
Show to me now the empty tomb,
May I be willing, Lord, to bear
Even Thy cup of grief to share,
Thou hast borne all for me.

songs.title: Whiter Than Snow
lyrics: [G]Now wash me, and I shall be [D7]whiter than [G]snow.
Lord Jesus, look down from Thy throne in the skies,
And help me to make a complete sacrifice;
I give up myself, and whatever I know;
Now wash me, and I shall be whiter than snow.
Lord Jesus, for this I most humbly entreat;
I wait, blessed Lord, at Thy crucified feet,
By faith, for my cleansing; I see Thy blood flow;
Now wash me, and I shall be whiter than snow.
Lord Jesus, Thou seest I patiently wait;
Come now, and within me a new heart create;
To those who have sought Thee,
Now wash me, and I shall be whiter than snow.

songs.title: Lord, I Want to Be a Christian
lyrics: [D]Lord, I want to be a [A]Christian in my heart, in [G]my [D]heart,
[D]Lord, I want to be a [A]Christian [G]in my [D]heart.
[D]Lord, I want to be a [A]Christian [G]in my [D]heart.
Lord, I want to be more loving in my heart, etc.
Lord, I want to be more like Jesus in my heart, etc.

songs.title: Lord of Creation
lyrics: Lord of all power, I give you my will,
In joyful obedience your tasks to fulfill.
Your bondage is freedom; your service is song;
And held in your keeping, my weakness is strong.
Lord of all wisdom, I give you my mind,
Rich truth that surpasses man's knowledge to find;
What eye has not seen and what ear has not heard
Is taught by your spirit and shines from your word.
Lord of all being, I give you my all,
If I ever disown you, I stumble and fall;
But led in your service your word to obey,
I'll walk in your freedom to the end of the way.

songs.title: My Jesus, I Love Thee
lyrics: And praise [A]Thee as [E]long as Thou [B7]lendest me [E]breath;

songs.title: Nothing Between
lyrics: habits of life, though harmless they seem,
must not my heart from him ever sever;
he is my all, there's nothing between.
Nothing between, e'en many hard trials,
though the whole world against me convene;
watching with prayer and much self denial,
I'll triumph at last, there's nothing between.

songs.title: O for a Heart to Praise My God!
lyrics: [G]O [D]for [G]a heart to [C]praise my [G]God, [Em]A heart from [A7]sin set [D]free,
Where only Christ is heard to speak,
A heart in every thought renewed
Perfect and right and pure and good,
Write Thy new name upon my heart,
Thy new, best name of Love.

songs.title: Just as I Am, Thine Own to Be
lyrics: Just as I am, Thine own to be,
Friend of the young, who lovest me,
In the glad morning of my day,
My life to give, my vows to pay,
With no reserve and no delay,
With all my heart I come.
I would live ever in the light,
I would work ever for the right;
I would serve Thee with all my might;
Just as I am, young, strong, and free,
To be the best that I can be
For truth, and righteousness, and Thee,
Lord of my life, I come.

songs.title: Jesus, I My Cross Have Taken
lyrics: [A]Jesus, I my cross have taken, [E]all to leave and [E7]follow Thee.
[A]Destitute, despised, forsaken, [E]Thou from hence my all [E7]shall [A]be.
[E]Perish every [E7]fond ambition, all [A]I've sought or [D]hoped or [E7]known.
[A]Yet how rich is my condition! [E7]God and heaven are [A]still [E7]my [A]own.
Let the world despise and leave me, they have left my Savior, too.
Human hearts and looks deceive me; Thou art faithful, Thou art true.
O, 'tis not in grief to harm me, while thy love is left to me;
O, 'twere not in joy to charm me, If that love be hid from me.
Soul, then know thy full salvation; rise o'er sin, and fear, and care;
Joy to find in every station something still to do or bear
Think what Spirit dwells within thee; Think what Father's smiles are thine;
Think that Jesus died to win thee, child of heaven, canst thou repine?
Haste then on from grace to glory, armed by faith, and winged by prayer,
Heaven's eternal day's before thee, God's own hand shall guide thee there.
Soon shall close thy earthly mission, soon shall pass thy pilgrim days;
Hope soon change to glad fruition, faith to sight, and prayer to praise.

songs.title: Open My Eyes That I May See
lyrics: Glimpses of truth Thou [G]hast for me;
Ready, my God, Thy [G]will to see;
Open my ears that I may hear
Voices of truth Thou sendest clear;
and while the wavenotes fall on my ear,
Open my mouth, and let me bear
Open my heart, and let me prepare

lyrics: [G]Must Jesus bear the [C]cross alone, and [G]all the world go [D]free?

till He shall set me free;
and then go home my crown to wear,

with joy I'll cast my golden crown,

songs.title: Take the World, but Give Me Jesus
lyrics: [F]Take the world, but give me [C7]Jesus, All its joys are but a [F]name;
[F]But His love abideth [C7]ever, Through eternal years the [F]same.
Oh, the [Bb]height and depth of [F]mercy! Oh, the [C]length and [G7]breadth of [C]love!
Oh, the [F]fullness of [C7]redemption, Pledge of endless life [F]above!
Take the world, but give me Jesus,
With my Savior watching o'er me,
I can sing, though billows roll.
Take the world, but give me Jesus;
Let me view his constant smile;
Light will cheer me all the while.
Take the world, but give me Jesus;
In His cross my trust shall be,
Face to face my Lord I see.

songs.title: Take My Life and Let It Be
lyrics: Take my feet, and let them be
Take my voice, and let me sing
Take my lips, and let them be
Take my silver and my gold
Not a mite would I withhold;
Not a mite would I withhold.
Take my will, and make it Thine,
It shall be no longer mine;
Take my heart, it is Thine own,
It shall be Thy royal throne.
It shall be Thy royal throne.
Take my love, my Lord, I pour
At Thy feet its treasure store;
Take myself, and I will be,

songs.title: O Jesus, I Have Promised
lyrics: [F]O Jesus, I have [C]promised To [C7]serve Thee to the [F]end;
[E]I [F]shall not fear the [C]battle If [C7]Thou art by my [F]side,
Nor [D7]wander from the [Gm]pathway If [F]Thou wilt [C7]be my [F]Guide.
O let me feel thee near me!
I see the sights that dazzle,
my foes are ever near me,
and shield my soul from sin.
that where thou art in glory
to serve thee to the end;
