who hath said to them, "Well done."
So, although I'm not an angel,
yet I know that over there
I will join a blessed chorus
I will sing about my Savior,
died to set the sinner free.

songs.title: I Shall See the King
lyrics: [G]In His glory, I shall see the King,
In the land of song, in the glory throng,
Where there never comes a night,
With my Lord once slain I shall ever reign
In the glory land of light.
I shall see the King, all my tributes bring,
And shall look upon His face;
Then my song shall be how He ransomed me
And has kept me by His grace.

songs.title: No Night There
lyrics: All the gates of pearl are made,
All the streets with gold are laid,
And the gates shall never close
There they need no sunshine bright,
For the Lamb is all the light,

songs.title: Sweet By and By
lyrics: [G]And by faith we can see it [D]afar;
And by faith we can see it [D7]afar;
In the [G]sweet (in the sweet) By and [D]by (by and by),
In the [G7]sweet (in the sweet) By and [C]by (by and by)
Not a sigh for the [D7]blessing of [G]rest.
We will offer our tribute of [D7]praise;

songs.title: Jerusalem the Golden
lyrics: They stand, those hall of Zion,
And bright with many an angel,
The Prince is ever in them,
There is the throne of David,
The shout of them that triumph,
The song of them that feast;
And they who, with their Leader,
Are clad in robes of white.
To  that dear land of rest;
Who art, with God the Father,

songs.title: Joy By and By
lyrics: [A]O there'll be joy when the [E]work is done,
[A]Joy, joy, joy, there'll be [E]joy by and by,
Sweet are the songs that we hope to sing,
Grateful the thanks our hearts shall bring,
Pure are the joys that await us there,

songs.title: Over Yonder
lyrics: Come go with me to homeland,

songs.title: Shall We Gather at the River
lyrics: [C]Shall we gather at the river, [G7]where bright angel feet have trod,
[C]With its crystal tide forever Flowing [G7]by the throne of [C]God?
[C]On the margin of the river, [G7]washing up its silver spray,
[C]we will walk and worship ever, all the [G7]happy golden [C]day.
[C]Ere we reach the shining river, [G7]lay we every burden down;
[C]grace our spirits will deliver, and [G7]provide a robe and [C]crown.
[C]Soon we'll reach the shining river, [G7]soon our pilgrimage will cease;
[C]soon our happy hearts will quiver with the [G7]melody of [C]peace.

songs.title: Ten Thousand Times Ten Thousand
lyrics: The armies of the ransomed saints
Throng up the steeps of light.
Their fight with death and sin.
Fling open wide the golden gates,
Fills all the earth and sky!
The ringing of a thousand harps
And all its tribes were made!
O joy, for all its former woes
Then eyes with joy shall sparkle,
That brimmed with tears of late;
Fill up the roll of Thine elect,
Then take Thy power and reign!
Show in the heavens Thy promised sign;

songs.title: We Speak of the Realms
lyrics: [F]We speak of the realms of the blest,
We speak of its freedom of sin,
But what must it be to be there!
We  speak of its service of love,
Of the robes which glorified wear,
Of the church of the First Born above-
But what must it  be to be there!
Our mourning is all at an end,
When, raised by the life-giving word,
We see the new city descend,
Adorned as a bride for her Lord;
The city so holy and clean,
No sorrow can breathe in the air;
No gloom of affliction or sin,
No shadow of evil, is there.
Do Thou, midst temptation and woe,
And shortly I also so shall know
And feel what it is to be there.
Then o'er the bright fields we shall roam,
With saints and with angels at home,
And Jesus Himself will be there.

songs.title: The Glory Song
lyrics: When all my labors and trails are o'er,
[D7]And I am safe on that [G]beautiful shore,
[G]When by His grace I shall [C]look on His [B]face,
When, by the gift of His infinite grace,
I am accorded in heaven a place,
Just to be there and to look on His face,
Will through the ages be glory for me.
Friends will be there I have loved long ago;
Joy like a river around me will flow,
Yet, just a smile form my Savior, I know,
Will through the ages be glory for me.

songs.title: The Homeland
lyrics: The land of the free born!
There's no night in the homeland,
There is no pain in the homeland
There is no pain in the homeland
My Lord is in the homeland,
There's no sin in the homeland,
And when I think of the homeland
My eyes are filled with tears;
And when I think of the homeland
My  ears are filled with tears.
Christ bring us all to the homeland
Christ bring us all to the homeland

songs.title: I'm Going Home
lyrics: My heav'nly home is bright and fair,
Nor pain nor death can enter there;
It's glitt'ring tow'rs the sun outshine,
That heav'nly mansion shall me mine.
I'm going home, I'm going home,
I'm going home to die no more;
To die no more; to die no more-
I'm going home to die no more.
My Father's house is built on high,
Far, far above the starry  sky;
When from this earthly prison free,
That heav'nly mansion mine shall be.
Let others seek a home below,
Which flames devour or waves oe'r flow;
Be mine a happier lot to own
A heav'nly mansion near the throne.

songs.title: You Will See Your Lord A-Coming
lyrics: You will see the saints arising,
You will see the saints arising,
You will see the saints arising
Angels bear them to the Savior,
Angels bear them to the Savior,
Angels bear them to the Savior
Then we'll shout, our suff'ring over,
Then we'll shout, our suff'ring over,
Then we'll shout, our suff'ring over

songs.title: How Far From Home?
lyrics: Then [G]weep no more, but [C]speed thy flight,
I asked the warrior on the field;
"With courage, bold, the sword I'll wield,
Then weep no more, but well endure
The conflict, till thy work is done;
For this we know, the prize is sure,
I asked again; earth, sea, and sun
Seemed, with one voice, to make reply
Then weep no more-with warning tones,
Not far from home! O blessed thought!
The traveler's lonely heart to  cheer;
Which oft a healing balm has brought,
Then weep no more, since we shall meet
Our trails past, our joys complete,

songs.title: How Cheering Is the Christian's Hope
lyrics: How cheering is the Christian's hope,
It bouys us up while this passing through
It bouys us up while this passing through
It bouys us up while passing through
It points us to a land of rest,
Where saints with Christ will reign;
Where we shall meet the loved of earth,
Fly, lingering moments, fly, O, fly,
We long to see Thee as Thou art,

songs.title: I Saw One Weary
lyrics: [G]I saw one weary, [D7]sad, and torn, With [G]eager [D]steps [Em]press [D]on the [D7]way,
Who [G]long the hallowed [D7]cross had borne, Still [G]looking [C]for the [D7]promised [G]day;
[G]While many a line of [D7]grief and care, [G]Upon his [D]brow, [Em]was [D]furrowed [D7]there;
I [G]asked what buoyed his [D7]spirits up, O [G]this! said [C]he—the [G]blessed hope.
And one I saw, with sword and shield,
Who boldly braved the world's cold frown,
And fought, unyielding, on the field,
Though worn with toil, oppressed by foes,
No murmur from his heart arose;
I asked what buoyed his spirits up,
And there was one who left behind
The cherished friends of early years,
To tread the path bedewed with tears.
Through trials deep and conflict sore,
Yet still a smile of joy he wore;
O! what can buoy the spirit up?
While pilgrims here we journey on
In this dark vale of sin and gloom,
Or through the portals of the tomb,
Till our returning King shall come
To take His exile captives home,
O! what can buoy the spirits up?

songs.title: How Sweet Are the Tidings
lyrics: [C]How sweet are the tidings that greet the [G7]pilgrim's [C]ear,
The mossy  old graves where the pilgrims sleep
Shall be open as wide as before,
And the millions that sleep in the mighty deep
Shall live on this earth once more.
There we'll meet ne'er to part in our happy
Eden home, Sweet songs of redemption we'll sing;
From the north, from the south, all the ransomed shall come,
Soon, if faithful, we all shall be there;
O, be watchful, be hopeful, be joyful till then,
And a crown of bright glory we'll wear.

songs.title: There'll Be No Sorrow There
lyrics: There'll be no night in heaven,
No anxious toil, no weary hours;
In heaven above, where all is love,
There'll be no grief in heaven;
For life is one glad day,
And tears are those of former things
There'll be no sin in heaven;
All holy in there spotless robes,

songs.title: I'm a Pilgrim
lyrics: Do not [C]detain me, for I am [F]going
There the glory is ever shining!
O, my longing heart, my longing heart is there;
Here in this country so dark and dreary,
I long have wandered forlorn and weary.
There's the city to which I journey;
My Redeemer, my Redeemer is its light!
There is no sorrow, nor any sighing,
Nor any tears there, or any dying.

songs.title: I'm But a Stranger Here
lyrics: I shall reach home at last,
There are the good and blest,
Those I love most and best;
And there I, too, shall rest,

songs.title: Lo, What a Glorious Sight Appears
lyrics: [D7]Lo, [G]what a glorious sight appears To [D7]our believing [G]eyes!
[D7]The [G]earth and seas are passed away, And [D7]the old rolling [G]skies.
And [D7]the old rolling skies, And [G]the old [A7]rolling [D]skies;
[D7]The [G]earth and seas are passed away, And [Am]the old [D7]rolling [G]skies.
[G]O that will be joyful When we [D7]meet to part no [G]more!
When we [D]meet to part no more on [G]Canaan's [A7]happy [D]shore;
[D7]'Tis [G]there we'll meet at Jesus' feet, When we [Am]meet to [D7]part no [G]more!
His own soft hand shall wipe the tears
And pains, and groans, and griefs, and fears,
And pains, and groans, and griefs, and fears,
How long, dear Savior! Oh, how long
Fly swifter round, ye wheels of time!
Fly swifter round, ye wheels of  time!

songs.title: Long Upon the Mountains
lyrics: Now the light of truth they're seeking,
They are holy, just, and true.
On the words of lire they're feeding,
Precious to their taste so sweet;
In that light of light and beauty,
Soon its pearly gates they'll enter,
And of all its glories share.
Free from sin, and death, and pain;
Tear will never dim those mansions
Soon He comes! With clouds descending;
Shout their vict'ry thro' the skies.
O, we long for Thine appearing;

songs.title: O, When Shall I See Jesus
lyrics: [Em]O when shall I see Jesus, and [D]reign with Him above,
And shall [Em]hear the trumpet [Am]sound in that [Esus]morning?
Gird on the gospel armor of faith and hope and love,
And you'll hear the trumpet  sound in that morning.
And when the combat's ended He'll carry you above,
And you'll hear the trumpet sound in that morning.
Our ears shall hear with transport the host of heaven sing,
And shall hear the trumpet sound in that morning.
Our tongues shall chant the glories of our immortal King.
And shall hear the trumpet sound in that morning,

songs.title: Never Part Again
lyrics: [G7]What! Never part again? No, never part again,
And but a little space divides
Could we but stand where Moses stood,
Not all  this world's pretended good

songs.title: Together Let Us Sweetly Live
lyrics: Together let us watch and pray;
I am bound for the land of Canaan.
I am bound for the land of Canaan.
Our songs of praise shall fill the skies;
I am bound for the land of  Canaan.
While higher still our joys shall rise;
I am bound for the land of Canaan.
Then come with me, beloved friend;
I am bound for the land of Canaan.
The joys to come shall never end;
I am bound for the land of Canaan.

songs.title: What Heavenly Music
lyrics: On the banks of old Jordan, here gazing I stand,
And earnestly longing, I stretch forth my hand;
Send a convoy of angels, dear Jesus, I pray!
Let me join that sweet music; come, take me away.
Though dark are the waters and rough is the wave,
If Jesus permit, the wild surges I'll brave;
For that heavenly music hath ravished me so,
I must join in that chorus! I'll go! let me go!

songs.title: We Have Heard
lyrics: We have heard from the bright, the holy, land;
We have heard, and our hearts are glad;
For we were a lonely pilgrim band,
And weary, and worn, and sad.
They tell us the saints have a dwelling there-
And we know that the goodly land is fair,
They say green fields are waving there,
That never a blight shall know;
And the deserts wild are blooming fair,
And the roses of Sharon grow.
There are lovely birds in the bowers green,
Their songs are blithe and sweet;
And their warblings, gushing ever new,
We have heard of the palms, the robes, the crowns,
And the silvery band in white;
Of the city fair, with pearly gates,
We have heard of the angels there, and saints,
With their harps of gold, how they sing;
Of the mount with the fruitful tree of life,
Of the leaves that healing bring.
The King of that country, He is fair,
He's the joy and light of the place;
In His beauty we shall behold Him there,
And bask in His smiling face,
We'll be there, we'll be there in a little while,
We'll join the pure and the blest;
We'll have the palm, the robe, the crown,

songs.title: Don't You See My Jesus Coming
lyrics: Don't you see the saints ascending,
Hear them shouting thro' the air.
Now His glory they shall share.

songs.title: Immortal Love, Forever Full
lyrics: We nay not climb the heavenly steeps
To bring the Lord Christ down;
In vain we search the lowest deeps,
For him no depths can drown.
But warm, so tender, even yet
And  faith has still its Olivet,
The healing of His seamless dress
Is by our beds of pain;
We touch Him in life's throng and press,
Through Him the first fond prayers are said,
The last low whispers of our dead
O Lord and Master of us all
We own Thy sway, we hear Thy call,
We test our lives by Thine!

songs.title: My Lord and I
lyrics: He knows that I am weak,
And as He bids me lean on Him,
He leads me in the paths of light,
I tell Him all my sorrows,
I tell Him all my joys,
I tell Him all that pleases me,
He tells me what I ought to do,
He tells me how to try,
He knows that I am longing
And so He bids me go and speak
He bids me tell His wondrous love,
And why He came to die,

songs.title: I Love to Tell the Story
lyrics: I [G]love to tell the story of [C]unseen things [G]above,
Of [D]Jesus and [G]His glory of Jesus and his [D7]love
I love to tell the [G]story [Em]because I know 'tis [B7]true;
I [D]love to tell the [G]story, 'twill [C]be my theme in [G]glory
To tell the old, old [Am]story of [G]Jesus [D7]and his [G]love.
I [G]love to tell the story; more [C]wonderful it [G]seems
than [D]all the [G]golden fancies of all our golden [D7]dreams.
I love to tell the [G]story, it [Em]did so much for [B7]me;
and [C]that is just the [G]reason I [D7]tell it now to [G]thee.
I [G]love to tell the story; 'tis [C]pleasant to [G]repeat
What [D]seems each time [G]I tell it more wonderfully [D7]sweet
I love to tell the [G]story for [Em]some have never [B7]heard
I [G]love to tell the story, for [C]those who know it [G]best
Seem [D]hungering [G]and thirsting to hear it like the [D7]rest.
And when in scenes of [G]glory I [Em]sing the new, new [B7]song
'twill [C]be the old, old [G]story that [D7]I have loved so [G]long.

songs.title: More Love to Thee
lyrics: Once earthly joy I craved, sought peace and rest;
now thee alone I seek, give what is best.
This all my prayer shall be More love, O Christ, to thee;
more love to thee, more love to thee!
Let sorrow do its work, come grief and pain;
sweet are thy messengers, sweet their refrain,
when they can sing with me More love, O Christ, to thee;
more love to thee, more love to thee!
Then shall my latest breath whisper thy praise;
this be the parting cry my heart shall raise;
this still its prayer shall be More love, O Christ, to thee;
more love to thee, more love to thee!

songs.title: As the Bridegroom to His Chosen
lyrics: As the bridegroom to his chosen,
As the king to his realm,
As the keep unto the castle,
As the pilot to the helm,
So, Lord, art Thou to me.
As the fountain in the garden,
As the candle in the dark,
As the treasure in the coffer,
As the manna in the ark,
So, Lord, art Thou to me.
As the ruby in the setting,
As the honey in the comb,
As the light within the lantern,
As the father in the home,
So, Lord, art Thou to me.
As the sunshine in the heavens,
As the image in the glass,
As the fruits up in the fig tree,
As the dew upon the grass,
So, Lord, art Thou to me.

songs.title: As Water to the Thirsty
lyrics: Like calm in place of clamor
Like moonlight and starlight and sunlight on the sea,
So is my Lord, my living Lord,
So is my Lord to me.
As home to the trav'ler and all he longs to see,
So is my Lord, my Living Lord to me.

songs.title: Be Still, My Soul
lyrics: Be still, My soul thy God doth undertake
To guide the future as He has the past.
Thy hope, thy confidence let nothing shake;
All now mysterious shall be bright at last.
Be still, my soul when waves and winds still know
His voice who ruled them while He dwelth below.
Be still, my soul the hour is hastening on
When we shall be forever with the Lord,
When disappointment, grief, and fear are gone,
Sorrow forgot, love's purest joys restored.
Be still, my soul when change and tears are past,
All safe and  blessed we shall meet at last.

songs.title: Blessed Assurance, Jesus is Mine!
lyrics: [C]Blessed assurance, [F]Jesus is [C]mine! O what a [G]foretaste of [D7]glory [G]divine!
[C]Heir of salvation, [F]purchase of [C]God; Born of His [F]Spirit, [G7]washed in His [C]blood.
[C]This is [G7]my [C]story, [F]this is my [C]song, Praising my [F]Saviour [G]all the [D7]day [G]long.
[G7]This is my [C]story, [F]this is my [C]song, Praising my [F]Savior [G7]all the day [C]long.
[C]Perfect submission, [F]perfect [C]delight; Visions of [G]rapture now [D7]burst on my [G]sight.
[C]Perfect submission, [F]all is at [C]rest; I in my [G]Saviour am [D7]happy and [G]blest.
[C]Watching and waiting, [F]looking [C]above; Filled with His [F]goodness, [G7]lost in His [C]love.

songs.title: Peace, Perfect Peace
lyrics: Peace, perfect peace, by thronging duties pressed?
To do the will of Jesus this is rest.
Peace, perfect peace, with loved ones far away?
In Jesus' keeping we are safe, and they.
Peace, perfect peace, our future all unknown?
Jesus we know, and He is on the throne.

songs.title: When I Can Read My Title Clear
lyrics: When [G]I can read my [C]title clear [G]To [D]mansions [C]in the [G]skies
Should earth against my soul engage, And fiery darts be hurled,
Then I can smile at Satan's rage, And face a frowning world;
And face a frowning world, And face a frowning world,
Then I can smile at Satan's rage, And face a frowning world.
Let cares like a wild deluge come, And storms or sorrow fall!
May I but safely reach my home, May God, my heav'n, my all;
My God. my heav'n, my all, My God, my heav'n, my all,
May I but safely reach my home, My God, my heav'n, my all.

songs.title: I Heard the Voice of Jesus
lyrics: I heard the voice of Jesus say,
Stoop down and drink and live."
I came to Jesus, and I drank
My thirst was quench'd, my soul revived,
And now I live in Him.
I heard the voice of Jesus say,
Look unto Me, thy morn shall rise,
And all thy day be bright."
I looked to Jesus, and I found
In Him my star, my sun;
And in that light of  life I'll walk,

songs.title: Wonderful Peace
lyrics: [G]Far away in the depths of my [C]spirit [G]tonight,
What a treasure I have in this wonderful peace,
Buried deep in my inner most soul,
So secure that no power can mine it away,
While the years of eternity roll!
I believe when I rise to that city of peace,
Where the Author of peace I shall see,
That one strain of the song which the ransomed will sing,
In that heavenly kingdom will be-
Weary soul, without gladness or comfort or rest,
Passing down the rough pathway of time!
Make the Savior your friend ere the shadows grow dark;
O accept of this peace so sublime.

songs.title: Life Is Great! So Sing About It
lyrics: Life is great! So sing about it,
As we can and as we should-
Shop and buses, towns and people,
Life is great and life is given;
Life is lovely, free and good.
Life is great!- what ever happens,
Snow or sunshine, joy or pain,
Life is great if someone loves me,
Holds my hand and calls my name.
Love is great!- the love of lovers,
Love that gazes at the cradle
Where a child of loving lies;
Love that lasts when youth has faded,
Bends with age, but never dies.
Boy and girl, or friend with friend;
All the hurts that hate can send;
Love's the greatest way of living,
God is great! in  Christ He loved us,
As we should, but never can-
Love that suffered, hoped and trusted
Love that broke through death forever.

songs.title: A Child of the King
lyrics: [D]My Father is rich in houses and lands,
He [A]holdeth the wealth of the world in His [D]hands!
[D]Of rubies and diamonds, of [G]silver and gold,
[D]I'm a child of the King, A child of the King
My Father's own Son, the Savior of men,
Once wandered on earth as the poorest of them;
But now He is pleading our pardon on high,
That we may be His when He comes by and by.
I once was an outcast stranger on earth,
A sinner by choice, an alien by birth,
But I've been adopted, my name's written down,
An heir to a mansion, a robe and a crown.
A tent or a cottage, why should I care?
They're building a palace for me over there;
Though exiled from home, yet still may I sing
All glory to God, I'm a child of the King.

songs.title: Leaning on the Everlasting Arms
lyrics: [G]what a blessedness, [C]what a peace is mine,
[G]O how sweet to walk [C]in this pilgrim way,
[G]O how bright the path [C]grows from day to day,
[G]What have I to dread, [C]what have I to fear,
[G]I have blessed peace [C]with my Lord so near,

songs.title: There's Sunshine in My Soul Today
lyrics: There's music in my soul today,
There's springtime in my soul today,
For when the Lord is near,
The dove of peace sings in my heart,
Theres gladness in my soul today,
And hope, and praise, and love,
For blessings which He gives me now,

songs.title: Grant Us Your Peace
lyrics: Dona nobis pacem, pacem; Dona nobis pacem.
Dona nobis pacem; Dona nobis pacem.
Dona nobis pacem; Dona nobis pacem.
Father grant us, grant us Your peace;
Oh, loving Father, grant us Your peace.
Grant us, grant us, grant Your peace;
Loving Father, grant us Your peace.
Accordenous ta paix, ta paix, Accordenous ta paix.
Accordenous ta paix; Accordenous ta paix.
Accordenous ta paix, Accordenous ta paix.
Padre, danos tupaz, tupaz; Padre, danos, danos tupaz
Padre, danos, tupaz. Padre, danos, danos tupaz
Padre, danos tupaz. Padre, danos, danos tupaz.

songs.title: A Song of Heaven and Homeland
lyrics: The song of Heav'n and Homeland,
Now soft, and low, and restful,
It floods my soul with peace,
Of wind, and wave, and sea-
It fills the dome of heaven
It seems to catch the cadence
My heart is filled with rapture,
To think, some day to come,
I'll sing it with the angels-
The song of heav'n and home.

songs.title: Nearer My God, to Thee
lyrics: [G]Still all my song shall be, [C]Nearer [G]my God, to [D7]Thee,
Though like the wanderer, the sun gone down,
darkness be over me, my rest a stone;
yet in my dreams I'd be
nearer, my God, to thee, nearer to thee!
There let the way appear, steps unto heaven;
all that thou sendest me, in mercy given;
nearer, my God, to thee, nearer to thee!
Then, with my waking thoughts bright with thy praise,
out of my stony griefs Bethel I'll raise;
so by my woes to be
nearer, my God, to thee, nearer to thee!
Or if, on joyful wing cleaving the sky,
sun, moon, and stars forgot, upward I fly,
still all my song shall be,
nearer, my God, to thee, nearer to thee!

songs.title: Take the Name of Jesus With You
lyrics: [G]Take the name of Jesus with you, [C]child of sorrow and of [G]woe;
[D7]It will joy and comfort [G]give you, [D7]take it then, where'er you [G]go.
Precious [C]name, O how [G]sweet! Hope of earth and joy of [D]heav'n;
[D7]Precious [G]name, O how [C]sweet! Hope of [G]earth and [D7]joy of [G]heav'n;
Take the Name of Jesus ever,
As a shield from every snare;
Breathe that holy Name in prayer.
O the precious Name of Jesus!
How it thrills our souls with joy,
When His loving arms receive us,
And His songs our tongues employ!
At the Name of Jesus bowing,
King of kings in heav'n we'll crown Him,

songs.title: Balm in Gilead
lyrics: There is a balm in Gilead
There is a balm in Gilead
And think my work's in vain,
If you can not preach like Peter,
If you can not pray like Paul,
You can tell the love of Jesus,
And say He died for all.

songs.title: Burdens Are Lifted at Calvary
lyrics: Cast your care on Jesus today,
Troubled soul, the Saviour can see,

songs.title: Sweet Hour of Prayer
lyrics: [C]Sweet hour of prayer Sweet [F]hour of prayer That [C]calls me from a [G]world of care
And [C]bids me at my [F]Father's throne Make [C]all my wants and [G]wishes [C]known
[C]In seasons of distress and grief My soul has often found [G]relief
And [C]oft escaped the [F]tempter's snare By [C]Thy return, sweet [G]hour of [C]prayer
Sweet [C]hour of prayer! Sweet [F]hour of prayer!
The joys I feel, this bliss I share
Of those whose anxious spirits burn
With strong desires for Thy return!
With such I hasten to the place
Where God my saviour shows His face,
And gladly take my station there,
And wait for Thee, sweet hour of prayer!

songs.title: Dear Lord and Father
lyrics: In simple trust like theirs who heard,
the gracious calling of the Lord,
let us, like them, without a word,
where Jesus knelt to share with thee
Drop thy still dews of quietness,
take from our souls the strain and stress,
and let our ordered lives confess
Breathe through the heats of our desire
let sense be dumb, let flesh retire;
speak through the earthquake, wind, and fire,
O still, small voice of calm.

songs.title: Dear Lord and Father
lyrics: In simple trust like theirs who heard,
the gracious calling of the Lord,
let us, like them, without a word,
where Jesus knelt to share with thee
Drop thy still dews of quietness,
take from our souls the strain and stress,
and let our ordered lives confess
Breathe through the heats of our desire
let sense be dumb, let flesh retire;
speak through the earthquake, wind, and fire,
O still, small voice of calm.

songs.title: Father, Lead Me Day by Day
lyrics: When in danger, make me brave; Make me know that Thou canst save;
Keep me safe by Thy dear side; Let me in Thy love abide.
When tempted to do wrong, Make me steadfast, wise, and strong;
And when all alone I stand, Shield me with Thy mighty hand.
May I do the good I know, Be Thy loving child below,
Then at last go home to Thee, Evermore Thy child to be.

songs.title: I Need Thee Every Hour
lyrics: [G]I need Thee, [C]O [G]I need [D]Thee; [D7]Every hour I need [G]Thee!

songs.title: I Need Thee, Precious Jesus
lyrics: I need the heart of Jesus to feel each anxious care,
To tell my every trial, and all my sorrows share.
I need the Holy Spirit to teach me what I am,
To show me more of Jesus, to point me to the Lamb.
I need Thee precious Jesus, I hope to see Thee soon,
Encircled with the rainbow, and seated on Thy throne.
There with Thy blood-bought children, my joy shall ever be
To sing Thy ceaseless praises, to gaze, my Lord, on Thee.

songs.title: I Must Tell Jesus
lyrics: [D]I must tell Jesus all of my [A7]trials;
I can not bear these burdens [A]alone,
[D]I must tell Jesus! I must tell [G]Jesus!
[D]I must tell Jesus! I must tell [A7]Jesus!
I must tell Jesus all of my troubles,
He is a kind, compassionate Friend;
If I but ask Him He will deliver,
Make of my troubles quickly an end.
Oh, how the world to evil allures me!
Oh, how my heart is tempted to sin!
I must tell Jesus, and He will help me
Over the world the vict'ry to win.

songs.title: I Do Believe
lyrics: On Thy dear Son I now believe,
O let me feel Thy power;
And all my varied wants relieve,
Author of faith! To Thee I lift
O let me now receive that gift;
Surely Thou canst not let me die;
O speak, and I shall live;
And here I will unwearied lie,
How would my fainting soul rejoice
Could I but see Thy face!
Now let me hear Thy quickening voice,
I do believe, I now believe
And that He shed His precious blood
From sin to set me free.

songs.title: In the Garden
lyrics: While the [C]dew is still on the [G]roses;
And He [G]walks with me, And He [D7]talks with me,
And the joy we [B7]share as we [Em]tarry [C]there,
While the [C]dew is still on the [G]roses;
And the [D]voice I hear, falling [G]on my [Em]ear,
And He [G]walks with me, and He [D]talks with me
And He [D7]tells me I am His [G]own;
He speaks, and the sound of His voice
Is so sweet the birds hush their singing,
And the melody that He gave to me
I'd stay in the garden with Him
Though the night around me be falling,
But He bids me go; through the voice of woe,
His voice to me is calling.

songs.title: At First I Prayed for Light
lyrics: [G]At first I [C]prayed [G]for [D7]light Could I but see the [Em]way,
And next I prayed for strength
That I might tread the road
With firm, unfaltering feet, and win
And then I asked for faith
Could I but trust my God,
I'd live infolded in His peace,
But now I pray for love
Deep love to God and man;
A living love that will not fail,
And light and strength and faith

songs.title: Jesus, Lover of My Soul
lyrics: Hangs my helpless soul on thee;
Leave O leave me not alone!
All my trust on Thee is stayed,
All my help from Thee I bring;
With the shadow of Thy wing.
Thou, O Christ, all I want,
More than all in Thee I find;
Raise the fallen, cheer the faint,
Heal the sick, and lead the blind.
Just and holy is Thy name,
Vile and full of sin I am;
Thou art full of truth and grace.
Plenteous grace with Thee is found-
Grace to pardon all my sin;
Make and keep me pure within;
Thou of life the Fountain art,
Freely let me take of Thee;
Spring Thou up within my heart,

songs.title: Jesus, Lover of My Soul
lyrics: Other refuge have I none, hangs my helpless soul on Thee;
Leave, ah! leave me not alone, still support and comfort me.
All my trust on Thee is stayed, all my help from Thee I bring;
Cover my defenseless head with the shadow of Thy wing.
Thou, O Christ, art all I want, more than all in Thee I find;
Raise the fallen, cheer the faint, heal the sick, and lead the blind.
Just and holy is Thy Name, I am all unrighteousness;
False and full of sin I am; Thou art full of truth and grace.
Plenteous grace with Thee is found, grace to cover all my sin;
Let the healing streams abound; make and keep me pure within.
Thou of life the fountain art, freely let me take of Thee;
Spring Thou up within my heart; rise to all eternity.

songs.title: In the Hour of Trial
lyrics: In the hour of trial, Jesus, plead for me,
Lest by base denial I depart from Thee;
When Thou see'st me waver, with a look recall,
Nor, for fear or favor, suffer me to fall.
With forbidden pleasures would this vain world charm;
Or its sordid treasures spread to work me harm;
Bring to my remembrance sad Gethsemane,
Or, in darker semblance, cross-crowned Calvary.
Should Thy mercy send me sorrow, toil, and woe,
Or should pain attend me on my path below,
Grant that I may never fail Thy hand to see;
Grant that I may ever cast my care on Thee.

songs.title: Like Jesus
lyrics: Teach me as the days go by,
Teach me not to reason why,
Teach me that to do and die,
Teach me that the time is short,
Teach me how to live and work,
Teach me that to never shirk
Teach me how we may be one,
Like the Father and the Son;

songs.title: Fill My Cup, Lord
lyrics: [G]Like the woman at the [Abdim6]well I was [D7]seeking
"Draw from [D7]my well that never shall [G]run dry".
Fill [C]my cup [G]Lord, I lift it [D7]up, Lord!
Come and quench this thirsting of my [G]soul;
Fill my [D7]cup, [Am7]fill it [D7]up and make me [G]whole!
There are millions in this world who are craving
But none can match the wondrous treasure
That I find in Jesus Christ my Lord.
So, my brother, if the things this world gave you
Leave hungers that won't pass away,
My blessed Lord will come and save you,
If you kneel to Him and humbly pray

songs.title: We Would See Jesus
lyrics: "We would see Jesus," Rock of our salvation,
Where on our feet were set with sovereign grace;
Not life, nor death, with all their agitation,
Can thence remove us, gazing on His face.
"We would see Jesus;" other lights are paling,
Which for long years we did rejoice to see;
The blessings of this sinful world are failing;
We would not mourn them, in exchange for Thee.
"We would see Jesus;" this is all we're needing-
Strength, joy and willingness come with the sight;
We would see Jesus, dying, risen, pleading,
Soon to return and end this mortal night!

songs.title: Near to the Heart of God
lyrics: There [C]is a place of [G7]quiet rest, [G]near to the heart [G7]of [C]God;
A [C]place where sin [G7]cannot molest, [G]near to the heart of [C]God.
Hold [F]us who wait [C]before Thee, [G7]near to the heart of [C]God.
There [C]is a place of [G7]comfort sweet, [G]near to the heart [G7]of [C]God;
a [C]place where we our [G7]Savior meet, [G]near to the heart of [C]God.
There [C]is place a place of [G7]full release, [G]near to the heart [G7]of [C]God;
a [C]place where all is [G7]joy and peace, [G]near to the heart of [C]God.

songs.title: Eternal Love, We Have No Good
lyrics: Eternal Love, we have no good to bring Thee,
No single good of all our hands have wrought,
No worthy music have we found to sing Thee,
No jewelled word, no quick up soaring thought.
And yet we come; and when our faith would falter
Show us, O Love, the quiet place of prayer,
The golden censer and the golden altar,
And the great angel waiting for us there.

songs.title: O Gracious Father of Mankind
lyrics: High heaven's Lord, our hearts' dear guest,
Thou dost not wait till human speech
Our dreams, our aims, our work, our lives
Thou hearest these, the good and ill,
The secret thought, the hidden plan,
O cleanse our prayers from human dross,
Until we labor for those gifts
Our best is but Thyself in us,
To hear Thy voice we need but love,
We would not bend Thy will to ours,
But blend our wills to Thine;
Not dreams, our aims, our work, our lives
Thou seekest us in love and truth
More than our minds seek Thee;
Through open gates Thy power flows in
Like flood tides from the sea.
No more we seek Thee from afar,
Nor ask Thee for a sign,
Content to pray in life and love
And toil, till all are Thine.

songs.title: Still, Still With Thee
lyrics: Alone with Thee, amid the mystic shadows,
The solemn hush of nature newly born;
Alone with Thee in breathless adoration,
In the calm dew and freshness of the morn.
Still, still with Thee! As to each newborn morning
A fresh and solemn splendor still is given,
So does this blessed consciousness, awaking,
Breathe each day nearness unto Thee and heaven.
So shall it be at last, in that bright morning,
When the soul waketh and life's shadows flee;
O in that hour, fairer than daylight dawning,
Shall rise the glorious thought, I am with Thee.

songs.title: What a Friend We Have in Jesus
lyrics: Have we trials and temptations?  Is there trouble anywhere?
We should never be discouraged Take it to the Lord in prayer.
Can we find a friend so faithful Who will all our sorrows share?
Jesus knows our every weakness Take it to the Lord in prayer.
Are we weak and heavy laden, Cumbered with a load of care?
Precious Savior, still our refuge Take it to the Lord in prayer.
Do your friends despise, forsake you?  Take it to the Lord in prayer.
In his arms he'll take and shield you; You will find a solace there.

songs.title: Take Time to Be Holy
lyrics: [F]Take time to be [Bb]holy, speak [C7]oft with thy [F]Lord;
[C7]Make friends of God's [F]children, [C7]help those who are [F]weak,
Take time to be holy, the world rushes on;
spend much time in secret with Jesus alone.
By looking to Jesus, like him thou shalt be;
thy friends in thy conduct his likeness shall see.
Take time to be holy, let him be thy guide,
and run not before him, whatever betide.
In joy or in sorrow, still follow the Lord,
and, looking to Jesus, still trust in his word.
Take time to be holy, be calm in thy soul,
each thought and each motive beneath his control.
Thus led by his spirit to fountains of love,
thou soon shalt be fitted for service above.

songs.title: 'Tis the Blessed Hour of Prayer
lyrics: [C]'Tis the blessed hour [Dm7]of [C]prayer, when our [F]hearts lowly bend[C],
And we gather to [F]Jesus, our [D7]Savior and [G]Friend;
[C]If we come to Him [Dm7]in [C]faith, His [F]protection to [C]share,
What a [F]balm for the [C]weary! O how sweet to [G]be [C]there!
What a [F]balm for the [C]weary! O how sweet to [G]be [C]there!
'Tis the blessed hour of prayer, when the Savior draws near,
With a tender compassion His children to hear;
When He tells us we may cast at His feet every care,
'Tis the blessed hour of prayer, when the tempted and tried
To the Savior who loves them their sorrows confide;
With a sympathizing heart He removes every care;
'Tis the blessed hour of prayer, trusting Him we believe,
That the blessings we're needing we'll surely receive;
In the fullness of this trust we shall lose every care;

songs.title: Sun of My Soul
lyrics: It is not night if Thou be [C]near;
When soft the dews of kindly sleep
Be my last thought how sweet to rest
Abide with me from morn till eve,
For without Thee I cannot live;
Abide with me when night is nigh,
For without Thee I dare not die.
Be near and bless me when I wake,
Ere through the world my way I take;
Till in the ocean of Thy love
I lose myself in heaven above.

songs.title: A Quiet Place
lyrics: [Am]Far from the [C7]rapid pace where [F]God can [A7]soothe my [Dm]troubled [Em]mind.
[Am]Or on a [C7]mountain tall, New [F]strength and [E7]courage [Am]there I [C7]find;
[Em7]I go [A7]prepared to face a [Dm]new day With [G7]love for all [C]mankind.

songs.title: Lord Jesus, Think on Me
lyrics: Lord Jesus, think on me, And purge away my sin;
From earth-born passions set me free, And make me pure within.
Lord Jesus, think on me, With care and woe oppressed;
Let me Thy loving servant be, And taste Thy promised rest.
Lord Jesus, think on me, Nor let me go astray;
Through darkness and perplexity Point Thou the heavenly way.
Lord Jesus, think on me, That I may sing above
To Father, Spirit, and to Thee, The strains of praise and love.

songs.title: I Need the Prayers
lyrics: [C]I need the prayers of those I love, While [G]trav'ling o'er life's rugged [C]way,
[C]That I may true and faithful be, And [G]live for Jesus every [C]day.
[C]I [F]want my friends to pray for [C]me, To bear my tempted soul [G]above,
[C]And [F]intercede with God for [C]me; I [G]need the prayers of those I [C]love.
I need the prayers of those I love,
To help me in each trying hour,
To bear my tempted sould to Him,
That He may keep me by His pow'r.
I want my friends to pray for me,
To hold me up on wing of faith,
That I may walk the narrow way,
Kept by our Father's glorious grace.

songs.title: A Mighty Fortress
lyrics: Did we in our own strength confide, our striving would be losing,
were not the right man on our side, the man of God's own choosing.
Dost ask who that may be?  Christ Jesus, it is he;
Lord Sabbaoth, his name, from age to age the same,
and he must win the battle.
And though this world, with devils filled, should threaten to undo us,
we will not fear, for God hath willed his truth to triumph through us.
The Prince of Darkness grim, we tremble not for him;
his rage we can endure, for lo, his doom is sure;
one little word shall fell him.
That word above all earthly powers, no thanks to them, abideth;
the Spirit and the gifts are ours, thru him who with us sideth.
Let goods and kindred go, this mortal life also;
the body they may kill; God's truth abideth still;

songs.title: Moment by Moment
lyrics: Dying with Jesus, by death reckoned mine,
Living with Jesus, a new life divine,
Looking to Jesus till glory doth shine,
Moment by moment, O Lord, I am Thine.
Moment by moment I'm kept in His love;
Moment by moment I've life from above;
Looking to Jesus till glory doth shine;
Moment by moment, O Lord, I am Thine.
Never a trial that He is not there,
Never a burden that He doth not bear,
Never a sorrow that He doth not share,
Moment by moment I'm under His care.
Never a heart-ache, and never a groan,
Never a teardrop and never a moan;
Never a danger but there on teh throne,
Moment by moment He thinks of His own.
Never a weakness that He doth not feel,
Never a sickness that He cannot heal;
Moment by moment, in woe or in weal,
Jesus, my Savior, abides with me still.

songs.title: Anywhere With Jesus
lyrics: [C]Anywhere with Jesus I can safely go;
[G7]Anywhere He leads me in this world [C]below.
Anywhere without Him dearest joys would fade;
[C]Anywhere with Jesus I am not alone;
[G7]Other friends may fail me, He is still my [C]own.
Though His hand may lead me over dreary ways,
[C]Anywhere with Jesus, over land and sea,
Ready as He summons me to go or stay;
[C]Anywhere with Jesus, I can go to sleep
Knowing I shall waken never more to roam;

songs.title: How Firm a Foundation
lyrics: "When through deep waters I call thee to go,
the rivers of woe shall not thee overflow;
for I will be with thee, thy troubles to bless,
and sanctify to thee thy deepest distress."

songs.title: If You But Trust in God to Guide You
lyrics: If you but trust in God to guide you
And place your confidence in Him,
You'll find Him always there beside you,
To give you hope and strength within.
For those who trust God's changeless love
Build on the rock that will not move.
What gain is there in futile weeping,
If you are in His care and keeping,
In sorrow will He love you less?
For He who took for you a cross
Will bring you safe through every loss.
In patient trust await His leisure
In cheerful hope, with heart content
To take whate'er your Father's pleasure
And all discerning love have sent;
Doubt not your inmost wants are known
To Him who chose you for His own.
Sing, pray, and keep His ways unswerving,
And trust His word; though undeserving,
You'll find His promise true to be.
God never will forsake in need
The soul that trusts in Him indeed.

songs.title: I Know Whom I Have Believed
lyrics: I know not how this saving faith To me He did impart,
Nor how believing in His word Wrought peace within my heart.
I know not how the Spirit moves, Convincing men of sin,
Revealing Jesus through the word, Creating faith in Him.
I know not when my Lord may come, At night or noonday fair,
Nor if I walk the vale with Him, Or meet Him in the air.

songs.title: Just When I Need Him Most
lyrics: Just when I need Him, Jesus is true,
Never forsaking, all the way through,
Just when I need Him most.
Just when I need Him most,
Just when I need Him most,
Jesus is near to comfort and cheer,
Just when I need Him most.
Just when I need Him, Jesus is strong,
Bearing my burdens all the day long;
For all my sorrow giving a song,
Just when I need Him most.
Just when I need Him most,
Just when I need Him most,
Jesus is near to comfort and cheer,
Just when I need Him most.
Just when I need Him, He is my all,
Answering when upon Him I call;
Tenderly watching lest I should fall,
Just when I need Him most.
Just when I need Him most,
Just when I need Him most,
Jesus is near to comfort and cheer,
Just when I need Him most.

songs.title: In Heavenly Love Abiding
lyrics: In heavenly love abiding, No change my heart shall fear;
And safe is such confiding, For nothing changes here.
The storm may roar without me, My heart may low be laid;
But God is round about me, And can I be dismayed?
Wherever He may guide me, No want shall turn me back;
My Shepherd is besided me, And nothing can I lack.
His wisdom ever waketh, His sight is never dim;
He knows the way He taketh, And I will walk with Him.
Green pastures are before me, Which yet I have not seen;
Bright skies will soon be o'er me, Where darkest clouds have been.
My hope I cannot measure, My path to life is free;
My Savior has my teasure, And He will walk with me.

songs.title: Lord of Our Life
lyrics: Lord of our life, and God of our salvation,
Star of our night, and hope of every nation,
Hear and receive Thy church's supplication,
Lord, Thou canst help when earthly armor faileth;
Lord, Thou canst save when deadly sin assaileth;
Lord, o'er Thy rock nor death nor hell prevaileth;
Peace in our hearts our evil thoughts assuaging;
Peace in Thy church, where brothers are engaging;
Peace, when the world its busy war is waging;
Grant us Thy help till foes are backward driven;
Grant them Thy truth that they may be forgiven;
Grant peace on earth, and, after we have striven,

songs.title: The Lord Is My Light
lyrics: [D7]The [G]Lord is my [D7]light; then why should I [G]fear?
By [C]day and by [G]night His presence is [D]near;
[G]The Lord is my [D]light; my [G]joy and my [D]song;
[D7]The [G]Lord is my [D7]light, my joy and my [G]song;
The Lord is my light; though clods may arise,
Faith, stronger than sight, looks up to the skies
Where Jesus forever in glory doth reign
Then how can I ever in darkness remain?
The Lord is my light, the Lord is my strength;
I know in His might I'll conquer at length;
My weakness in mercy He covers with power,
And, walking by faith, He upholds me each hour.
The lord is my light, my all and in all;
There is in His sight no darkness at all;
He is my Redeemer, my Savior and King;
With saints and with angels His praises I sing.

songs.title: All the Way
lyrics: [G]All the way my savior leads me;
Here by faith in Him to [D]dwell!
All the way my Savior leads me;
Cheers each winding path I tread;
Gives me grace for every trial,
Feeds me with the living bread;
Though my weary steps may falter,
And my soul athirst may be,
Gushing from the Rock before me,
Lo, a spring of joy I see;
Gushing from the Rock before me,
Lo, a spring of joy I see.
All the way my Savior leads me;
O the fullness of His love!
Perfect rest to me is promised
When I wake to life immortal,
Wing my flight to realms of day,
This my song through endless ages,
Jesus led me all the way;
This my song through endless ages,
Jesus led me all the way.

songs.title: My Faith Looks Up to Thee
Standing on the Promises
lyrics: [G]Standing on the promises of Christ my King,
Glory in the highest I will shout and sing,
[G]Standing on the promises of Christ my King,
Glory in the highest I will shout and sing,
Standing on the promises that cannot fail,
When the howling storms of doubt and fear assail,
By the living word of God I shall prevail,
Standing on the promises of God.
Standing on the promises of Christ the Lord,
Bound to Him eternally by love's strong cord,
Overcoming daily with the Spirit's sword,
Standing on the promises of God.

songs.title: Give to the Winds Your Fears
lyrics: Give to the winds your fears;
God hears your sighs and counts your tears,
God shall lift up your head.
Your ways put in His hands
To His sure truth adn tender care
O put your trust in God;
Walk in His strength with faith and hope,
So shall your work be done.
So you shall, faithful, seek His way
how wise, how strong His hand!

songs.title: He Hideth My Soul
lyrics: He [C]hideth my soul in the [F]cleft of the rock,
He [G7]hideth my soul in the [C]cleft of [F]the [C]rock
He hideth my life in the [F]depths of His love,
A wonderful Savior is Jesus my Lord,
He holdeth me up, and I shall not be moved,
He giveth me strength as my day.
With numberless blessings each moment He crowns,
And filled with His fullness divine,
I sing in my rapture, Oh, Glory to God
For such a Redeemer as mine.
When clothed in His brightness, transported I rise
To meet Him in clouds of the sky,
His perfect salvation, His wonderful love,
I'll shout with the millions on high.

songs.title: Depth of Mercy
lyrics: I have long withstood His grace,
Long provoked Him to His face,
Would not hearken to His calls,
Grieved Him by a thousand falls.
Let me now my sins lament;
Weep, believe, and sin no more.
There for me the Savior stands,
Shows His wounds and spreads His hands;
God is love! I know, I feel;
Jesus weeps, and loves me still.

songs.title: My Hope Is Built on Nothing Less
lyrics: [C]My [F]hope is built on [C]nothing less [F]than [Bb]Jesus' blood and [C]righteousness.
[C]I [F]dare not trust the [C]sweetest frame, [F]but [Bb]wholly lean on [C]Jesus' [F]name.
[F]On Christ [C7]the [F]solid [Bb]rock I stand; all [F]other ground is sinking [C]sand,
I dare not trust the [D7]sweetest frame,
When Darkness veils his lovely face,
I rest on his unchanging grace.
in every high and stormy gale,
my anchor holds within the veil.
His oath, his covenant, his blood
supports me in the whelming flood.
When all around my soul gives way,
he then is all my hope and stay.
When He shall come with trumpet sound,
O may I then in him be found!
faultless to stand before the throne.

songs.title: My Faith Has Found a Resting Place
lyrics: My [G]faith has found a [D]resting [C]place, [E7]Not [Am]in a [G]manmade creed;
Enough for me that Jesus saves, This ends my fear and doubt;
A sinful soul, I come to Him, He will not cast me out.
My soul is resting on the Word, The living Word of God,
Salvation in my Savior's name, Salvation through His blood.
The great Physician heals the sick, The lost He came to save;
For me His precious blood He shed, For me His life He gave.

songs.title: 'Tis So Sweet to Trust in Jesus
lyrics: [G]'Tis so sweet to [C]trust in [G]Jesus, Just to take him [A]at his [D]word;
[G]Just to rest [C]upon his [G]promise, Just to [C]know, "Thus [D]saith the [G]Lord."
[G]Jesus, Jesus, [D]how I trust him! [G]How I've proved him [A]o'er and [D]o'er!

songs.title: Hiding in Thee
lyrics: In the calm of the noontide, in sorrow's lone hour,
In times when temptation casts over me its power;
In the tempests of life, on its wide, heaving sea,
Thou blest "Rock of Ages," I'm hiding in Thee.
How oft in the conflict, when pressed by the foe,
I have fled to my refuge and breathed out my woe;
How often, when trials like sea billows roll,
Have I hidden in Thee, O Thou Rock of my soul.

songs.title: Because He Lives
lyrics: An empty [G]grave is there to [D7]prove my Savior [G]lives.
And life is [G]worth the [C]living [D7]just because He [G]lives.
How sweet to hold a newborn baby,
And feel the pride, and joy He gives;
But greater still the calm assurance,
This child can face uncertain days because He lives.

songs.title: From Every Stormy Wind
lyrics: There is a place where Jesus sheds The oil of gladness on our heads,
A place than all besides more sweet; It is the blood-bought mercy seat.
There is a scene where spirits blend, Where friend holds fellowship with friend;
Though sundered far, by faith they meet Around one common mercy seat.
There, there, on angel's wings we soar, And earthly cares molest no more,
And heaven comes down our souls to greet, And glory crowns the mercy seat.
Ah! whither should we flee for aid, When tempted, desolate dismayed?
Or how the hosts of sin defeat, Had suffering saints no mercy seat?

songs.title: A Shelter in the Time of Storm
lyrics: [F]The Lord's our Rock, in [Gm]Him we hide, A [C]Shelter in the time of [F]storm;
[F]Secure whatever [Gm]may betide, A [C]Shelter in the time of [F]storm.
Mighty [Bb]Rock in a [F]weary land, Cooling shade on the [C]burning [F]sand,
Faithful [Bb]guide for the [F]pilgrim band A shelter in the [C7]time of [F]storm.
A shade by day, defense by night,
A shelter in the time of storm;
No fears alarm, no foes afright,
A shelter in the time of storm.
The raging storms may round us beat,
A shelter in the time of storm
We'll never leave our safe retreat,
A shelter in the time of storm.
O Rock divine, O Refuge dear,
A Shelter in the time of storm;
Be Thou our helper ever near,
A Shelter in the time of storm.

songs.title: Under His Wings
lyrics: Though the night deepens and tempests are [C]wild,
Still I [Cdim6]can [C]trust Him; I [F]know He will [C]keep me;
Under His wings, what a refuge in sorrow!
How the heart yearningly turns to its rest!
Often when earth has no balm for my healing,
There I find comfort, and there I am blest.
Under His wings, O what precious enjoyment!
There will I hide till life's trials are over;
Sheltered, protected, no evil can harm me;
Resting in Jesus I'm safe evermore.

songs.title: It Is Well With My Soul
We'll Build on the Rock
lyrics: We'll [B]build on the Rock, [G7]on the [D]solid Rock,
Some build on the sinking sands of life,
Some build on the waves of sin and strife,
O build on the Rock, for ever sure,
The firm and the true foundation;
Its hope is the hope which shall endure,

songs.title: Day by Day
lyrics: [D]Day by day, and with each passing [Em]moment,
Strength I [A]find to meet my trials [D]here;
I've no [A]cause for worry or for [D]fear.
[D]He, whose heart is kind beyond all [Em]measure,
Gives unto each [A]day what He deems [D]best,
Every day, the Lord Himself is near me
With a special mercy for each hour;
All my cares He fain would bear, and cheer me,
He whose name is Counselor and power.
The protection of His child and treasure
Is a charge that on Himself He laid;
As your days, your strength shall be in measure,
This the pledge to me He made.
Help me then in every tribulation
So to trust Thy promises, O Lord,
That I lose not faith's sweet consolation
Offered me within Thy holy Word.
Help me, Lord, when toil and trouble meeting,
E'er to take, as from a father's hand,
One by one, the days, the moments fleeting,
Till I reach the promised land.

songs.title: O for a Faith
lyrics: That will not murmur or complain
But in the hour of grief or pain, of grief or pain
Can lean upon its God; Can lean upon its God.
A faith that shines more bright and clear
That when in danger knows no fear, knows of no fear,
In darkness feels no doubt; In darkness feels no doubt.
That bears unmoved the world's dread frown,
That sin's wild ocean cannot drown, no, cannot drown,
Nor its soft arts beguile; Nor its soft arts beguile.
Lord, give me such a faith as this,
I'll taste, e'en here the hallowed bliss, the hallowed bliss
Of an eternal home; Of an eternal home.

songs.title: Will Your Anchor Hold
lyrics: Steadfast and sure while the billows [C]roll;
Grounded firm and deep [Bb]in the [F]Savior's love.
It is safely moored, 'twill the storm withstand,
For 'tis well secured by the Savior's hand;
And the cables passed from His heart to mine,
Can defy the blast, through strength divine.
It will firmly hold in the straits of fear,
When the breakers have told the reef is near;
Though the tempest rave and the wild winds blow,
Not an angry wave shall our bark o'erflow.
It will surely hold in the floods of death,
When the waters cold chill our latest breath;
On the rising tide it can never fail,
While our hopes abide within the veil.
When our eyes behold, in the dawning light,
Shining gates of pearl, our harbor bright,
We shall anchor fast to the heavenly shore,
With the storms all past forevermore.

songs.title: I Am Trusting Thee, Lord Jesus
lyrics: I am trusting Thee for pardon;
For Thy grace and tender mercy,
I am trusting Thee to guide me;
I am trusting Thee, Lord Jesus;

songs.title: God, Who Stretched the Spangled Heavens
lyrics: Flung the suns in burning radiance
Through the silent fields of space;
We, Your children in Your likeness,
Show us what we yet may do.
We have ventured worlds undreamed of
Since the childhood of our race;
Probed the secrets of the atom,
May our dreams prove rich with promise;
Till our goals and Yours are one.

songs.title: He Leadeth Me
lyrics: [C]He leadeth me, O [F]blessed thought! O [C]words with heavenly comfort [G]fraught!
[C]Whate'er I do, where[F]'er I be Still [C]'tis God's hand that [G]leadeth [C]me.
His [C]faithful [G]follower [C]I would be, [F]For [C]by His [Am]hand He [C]leadeth me.
[C]Sometimes mid scenes of [F]deepest gloom, [C]sometimes where Eden's bowers [G]bloom,
by [C]waters still, o'er [F]troubled sea, still [C]'tis his hand that [G]leadeth [C]me.
[C]Lord, I would place my [F]hand in thine, nor [C]ever murmur nor [G]repine;
[C]content, whatever [F]lot I see, since [C]'tis my God that [G]leadeth [C]me.
[C]And when my task on [F]earth is done, when [C]by thy grace the victory's [G]won,
e'en [C]death's cold wave I [F]will not flee, since [C]God through Jordan [G]leadeth [C]me.

songs.title: Guide Me, O Thou Great Jehovah
lyrics: whence the healing stream doth flow;
let the fire and cloudy pillar
lead me all my journey through.
be thou still my strength and shield;
be thou still my strength and shield.
When I tread the verge of Jordan,
death of death and hell's destruction,
land me safe on Canaan's side.
Songs of praises, songs of praises,
I will ever give to thee;
I will ever give to thee.

songs.title: I Will Early Seek the Savior
lyrics: I will hasten where He bids me,
I am not too young to go
In the pathway where He leadeth,
Not too young His will to know.
He is standing at the doorway
I will knock, for He has promised,
He will hear and let me in.

songs.title: Gentle Jesus, Meek and Mild
lyrics: Lamb of God, I look to Thee;
Thou art gentle, meek, and mild,
Thou wast once a little child.
Fain I would be as Thou art;
Let me have Thy loving mind.
I shall then show forth Thy praise,
Serve Thee all my happy days;
Then the world shall always see
Christ, the Holy Child, in me.

songs.title: Jesus, Friend So Kind
lyrics: Jesus, Friend, so kind and gentle,
Little ones we bring to Thee
Grant to them Thy dearest blessing,
Let Thine arms around them be;
Now enfold them in Thy goodness,
From all danger keep them free.
Thou who did receive the children
Give to all who teach and guide them
Vision true to keep them noble,

songs.title: Jesus, Friend of Little Children
lyrics: Take my hand and ever keep me
Teach me how to grow in goodness,
Thou hast been a child, and surely
Step by step, O, lead me onward,
Never leave me, nor forsake me;
For I need Thee from life's dawning

songs.title: Jesus, Son of Blessed Mary
lyrics: Once on earth a little child,
Though Thy eager heart was yearning
Grant that we, like little children,
Free from pride and guile my be;

songs.title: Savior, Like a Shepherd
lyrics: We are thine, thou dost befriend us, be the guardian of our way;
keep thy flock, from sin defend us, seek us when we go astray.
Blessed Jesus, blessed Jesus!  Hear, O hear us when we pray.
Blessed Jesus, blessed Jesus!  Hear, O hear us when we pray.
Thou hast promised to receive us, poor and sinful though we be;
thou hast mercy to relieve us, grace to cleanse and power to free.
Blessed Jesus, blessed Jesus!  We will early turn to thee.
Blessed Jesus, blessed Jesus!  We will early turn to thee.

songs.title: The Lord's My Shepherd
lyrics: My soul he doth restore again
And me to walk doth make
Even for his own name's sake.
Even for his own name's sake.
Yea, though I walk through death's dark vale
Yet will I fear no ill
For thou art with me, and thy rod
For thou art with me, and thy rod
My head thou dost with oil anoint
My head thou dost with oil anoint
Goodness and mercy all my life
And in God's house for evermore
And in God's house for evermore

songs.title: Now Praise the Hidden God of Love
lyrics: Now praise the hidden God of love
In whom we all must live and move,
Who shepherds us, at every stage
Who challenged us, when were young
To storm the citadels of wrong;
In care for others taught us how
Who bids us never lose our zest,
Tho' age is urging us to rest,
But proves to us that we have still
A work to do, a place to fill.
Then talk no more of wasted time,
But Godward look, and upward climb,
Content to sleep, when day is done,
And rise refreshed, and travel on.

songs.title: Loving Shepherd of Thy Sheep
lyrics: Teach Thy lamb Thy voice to hear;
Suffer not my steps to stray
From the straight and narrow way.
Where Thou leadest I would go,

songs.title: Every Flower That Grows
lyrics: Gracious Lord above, Looking down in love,
Guide my thoughts, my life, in my walk with Thee,
That day by day the world may see
Christ, the Lord and Savior, lives in me.
All my earthly days, I shall sing and praise
God the Father, Spirit, and Christ with the Son.
Grant faith when life on earth is done,
I shall sing with those whose rest is won.

songs.title: Jesus, Savior, Pilot Me
lyrics: As a mother stills her child,
thou canst hush the ocean wild;
when thou sayest to them, "Be still!"
When at last I near the shore,
then, while leaning on thy breast,
may I hear thee say to me,

songs.title: The Lord's My Shepherd
lyrics: My soul He doth restore again.
And me to walk doth make
E'en for His own name's sake.
Yea, though I walk in death's dark vale,

For Thou art with me; and Thy rod
My head Thou dost with oil anoint,
Goodness and mercy all my life

songs.title: Jesus, Guide Our Way
lyrics: So shall we, no more delaying,
Mid the darkness round us reigning
Through adversity lies our way to Thee.
In our toil, with aid be near us
In our need, with succour cheer us

songs.title: O Let Me Walk With Thee
lyrics: I cannot, dare not, walk alone;
The tempest rages in the sky,
A thousand snares beset my feet,
A thousand foes are lurking nigh.
Still Thou the raging of the sea,
O Master! let me walk with Thee.
If I may rest my hand in Thine,
I'll count the joys of earth but loss,
I'll bear the banner of the cross
Till Zion's glorious gates I see;
Yet, Savior, let me walk with Thee.

songs.title: Shepherd of Tender Youth
lyrics: We come Thy name to sin,
Thou are the great High Priest;
None call on Thee in vain;
Lead us where Thou hast trod,

songs.title: As Saints of Old
lyrics: As saints of old their first fruits brought
To God the giver all good,
So we today first fruits would bring
The wealth of this good land,
Of farm and market, shop and home,
Of mind, and heart, and hand.
A world in need now summons us
To make our life an offering
To God, that all may live.
The Church of Christ is calling us
To make the dream come true
A world redeemed by Christ-like love;
All life in Christ made new.
To serve Your cause and share Your love
O God, who gave yourself to us
Teach us to give ourselves each day

songs.title: Come, Ye Thankful People
lyrics: [F]Come, ye thankful [Bb]people, [F]come, Raise the song of [Bb]harvest [F]home;
God our Maker [F]doth provide [F7]for our wants to [Bb]be supplied;
We ourselves are God's own field,
Fruit unto His praise to yield;
First the blade and then the ear,
Then the full corn shall appear;
Grant, O harvest Lord, that we
Wholesome grain and pure may be.
For the Lord our God shall come,
And shall take His harvest home;
From His field shall purge away
All that doth offend, that day;
Give His angels charge at last
In the fire the tares to cast;
But the fruitful ears to store
Raise the song of harvest home;
Free from sorrow, free from sin,

songs.title: For the Fruits of His Creation
lyrics: In the just reward of labor, God's will is done;
In the hop we give our neighbor, God's will is done;
In our worldwide take of caring
In the harvests men are sharing, God's will is done.
For the harvests of His Spirit, thanks be to God;
For the good all men inherit, thanks be to God;
For the wonders that astound us,
For the truths that still confound us,
Most of all, that love has found us, thanks be to God!

songs.title: Now Thank We All Our God
Let All Things Now Living
lyrics: His banners are o'er [C7]us, [F]His [C7]light goes before [F]us,

songs.title: We Plow the Fields
lyrics: Ab  Db Bbm7 Ab Eb  Ab
He only is the Maker of all things near and far;
He paints the wayside flower, He lights the evening star.
The winds and waves obey Him, by Him the birds are fed;
Much more, to us His children, He gives our daily bread.
We thank Thee then, O Father, for all things bright and good,
The seed-time and the harvest, our life, our health, and food.
Accept the gifts we to offer for all Thy love imparts,
And, what Thou most desirest, our humble, thankful hearts.

songs.title: Come, Sing a Song of Harvest
lyrics: Come, sing a song of harvest, Of thanks for daily food!
To offer God the first-fruits is old as gratitude.
Long, long ago, the reapers, before they kept the feast,
Put first-fruits in a basket, and took it to the priest.
Shall we, sometimes forgetful oh where creation starts,
With science in our pockets lose wonder from our hearts?
May God, the great Creator, to whom all life belongs,
Accept these gifts we offer, our service and our songs.
And lest the world go hungry while we ourselves are fed,
Make each of us more ready to share our daily bread.

songs.title: Praise and Thanksgiving
lyrics: Praise and thanksgiving let everyone bring
Unto our Father for every good thing.

songs.title: For Sunrise Hope and Sunset Calm
lyrics: But O, we press far, far above these gifts of pure delight,
And find in Thee, and in Thy love contentment infinite.
O Lord, beloved, in whom are found all joys of time and place,
What will it be when joy is crowned by vision of Thy face?

songs.title: For the Beauty of the Earth
Father, We Thank You
lyrics: Father, we thank You for the light that shines all the day;
For the bright sky You have given most like Your heaven;
Father, we thank You for the lamps that lighten the way;
For human skill's exploration of Your creation;
Father, we thank You for the friends who brighten our play;
For Your command to call others sisters and brothers;
Father, we thank You for Your love in Jesus today,
Giving us hope for tomorrow through joy and sorrow;

songs.title: Make Me a Captive, Lord
lyrics: My heart is weak and poor until it amaster find;
It has no spring of action sure, it varies with the wind.
It cannot freely move till Thou has wrought its chain;
Enslave it with Thy matchless love, and deathless it shall reign.
My will is not my own till Thou hast made it Thine;
If it would reach a monarch's throne, it must its crown resign;
It only stands unbent, amid the clashing strife,
When on Thy bosom it has leant, and found in Thee its life.

songs.title: Pass Me Not, O Gentle Savior
lyrics: Let me at thy throne of mercy
Thou the spring of all my comfort,
whom have I on earth beside thee?

songs.title: Not I, But Christ
lyrics: Not I, but Christ, to gently soothe in sorrow,
Not I, but Christ, to wipe the falling tear;
Not I, but Christ, to lift the weary burden,
Not I, but Christ, to hush away all fear.
Christ, only Christ! No idle words e'er falling,
Christ, only Christ; no needless bustling sound;
Christ, only Christ, no self important bearing;
Christ, only Christ, no trace of "I" be found.
Not I, but Christ, my every need supplying,
Not I, but Christ, my strength and health to be;
Christ, only Christ, for body, soul, and spirit,
Christ, only Christ, here and eternally.

songs.title: What Does the Lord Require?
lyrics: What does the Lord require for praise and offering?
What sacrifice, desire or tribute bid you bring?
Do justly; Love mercy; Walk humbly with your God.
Rulers of men, give ear! Should you not justice show?
Will God your pleading hear, while crime and cruelty grow?
Do justly; Love mercy; Walk humbly with your God.
How shall our life fulfill God's law so hard and high?
Let Christ endue our will with grace to fortify.
Then justly, in mercy we'll humbly walk with God.

songs.title: Give of Your Best to the Master
lyrics: Give of your best to the master,
Give of the strength of your youth;
Join in the battle for truth.
Give of your best to the Master,
Give Him first place in your heart;
Give Him first place in your service,
Give, and to you shall be given -
Give Him the best that you have.
Give of your best to the Master,
Naught else is worthy His love;
He gave Himself for your ransom,
Laid down His life without murmur,
You from sin's ruin to save;
Give Him the best that you have.

songs.title: I'll Go Where You Want Me to Go
lyrics: [C]It may not be on the [F]mountain's height
But [G7]if by a still, small [C]voice He calls
I'll answer, dear [G7]Lord, with my [C]hand in [F]Thine;
I'll [G]go where You want me to [C]go, dear Lord,
I'll say what You [G7]want me to [C]say, dear [F]Lord;
Perhaps today there are loving words
Which Jesus would have me speak
There may be now in the paths of sin
Some wand'rer whom I should seek.
O Savior, if thou wilt be my guide,
Tho dark and rugged the way,
My voice shall echo the message sweet;
I'll say what you want me to say.
There's surely somewhere a lowly place
In earth's harvest fields so wide
Where I may labor through life's short day
So trusting my all to thy tender care,
I'll do thy will with a heart sincere
I'll be what you want me to be.

songs.title: O Master, Let Me Walk With Thee
lyrics: Help me the slow of heart to move
by some clear, winning word of love;
teach me the wayward feet to stay,
and guide them in the homeward way.
Teach me thy patience; still with thee
in work that keeps faith sweet and strong,
in trust that triumphs over wrong;
In hope that sends a shining ray
far down the future's broadening way,
in peace that only thou canst give,
with thee, O Master, let me live.

songs.title: Let Your Heart Be Broken
lyrics: Here on earth applying principles of love,
Visible expression ? God still rules above
Living illustration of the Living Word
To the minds of all who've Never seen or heard.
Blest to be a blessing privileged to care,
Challenged by the need apparent everywhere.
Where mankind is wanting, fill the vacant place.
Be the means through which the Lord reveals His grace.
Add to your believing deeds that prove it true,
Knowing Christ as Savior, make Him Master, too.
Follow in His footsteps, go where He has trod;
In the world's great trouble risk yourself for God.
Let your heart be tender and your vision clear;
See mankind as God sees, serve Him far and near.
Let your heart be broken by a brother's pain;
Share your rich resources, give and give again.

songs.title: Awake, Awake to Love and Work
lyrics: Come, let thy voice be one with theirs,
Shout with their shout of praise;
See how the giant sun soars up,
Great lord of years and days!
So let the love of Jesus come
To give and give, and give again,
To spend thyself nor count the cost;
The God who gave all worlds that are,
And all that are to be.

songs.title: In the Heart of Jesus
lyrics: In the mind of Jesus there is thought for you,
Warm as summer sunshine, sweet as morning dew;
Why should you be fearful, why take anxious thought,
Since the mind of Jesus cares for those He bought?
In the field of Jesus there is work for you;
Such as even angels might rejoice to do;
Why stand idly sighing for some lifework grand,
While the field of Jesus seeks your reaping hand?
In the home of Jesus there's a place for you;
Glorious, bright, and joyous, calm and peaceful too;
Why then, like a wanderer, roam with weary pace,
If the home of Jesus holds for you a place?

songs.title: So Send I You
lyrics: My name to [F7]bear, and in that name to [Bbmaj7]conquer—
So send I you- to take to souls in bondage
The word of truth that sets the captive fee,
To break the bonds of sin, to loose dearth's fetters-
So send I you, to bring the lost to Me.
So send I you- My strength to know in weakness,
My joy in grief, my perfect peace in pain,
To prove My power, My grace, My promised presence-
So send I you, eternal fruit to gain.
So send I you- to bear My cross with patience,
And then one day with joy to lay it down,
To hear My voice, "Well done, My faithful servant-
Come, share My throne, My kingdom, and My crown!"

songs.title: 'Tis Love That Makes Us Happy
lyrics: God is love; [A]we would be like [D]Him.
This world is full of sorrow,
With loving heart we'll do our part,
And try some soul to win.
And when this life is over,

lyrics: This little light of mine, I'm going to let it shine, (shine)
This little light of mine, I'm going to let it shine, (shine)
This little light of mine, I'm going to let it shine,
Let it shine, let it shine, let it shine.

All through the night, I'm going to let it shine,
Let it shine, let it shine, let it shine.

songs.title: When the Church of Jesus
lyrics: When the church of Jesus shuts its outer door,
Lest the roar of traffic drown the voice of prayer
May our prayers, Lord make up ten times more aware
That the world we banish is our Christian care.
If our hearts are lifted where devotion soars
High above this hungry suffering world of ours
Lest our hymns should drug us to forget its needs,
Forge our Christian worship into Christian deeds.
Lest the gifts we offer, money, talents, time,
Serve to salve our conscience to our secret shame
Lord, reprove, inspire us by the way you give;
Teach us, dying Savior, how true Christians live.

songs.title: Working, O Christ, With Thee
lyrics: Working, O Christ, with Thee, working with Thee,
Unworthy, sinful, weak, though we may be;
Our all to Thee we give, for Thee alone we live,
And by Thy grace achieve, working with Thee.
Along the city's waste, working with Thee,
Our eager footsteps haste, like Thee to be;
The poor we gather in, the outcasts raise from sin,
And labor souls to win, working with Thee.
Savior, we weary not, working with Thee,
As hard as Thine our lot can never be;
Our joy and comfort this, "Thy grace sufficent is;"
This changes toil to bliss, working with Thee.
So let us labor on, working with Thee,
Till earth to Thee is won, from sin set free;
Till men, from shore to shore, receive Thee, and adore,
And join us evermore, working with Thee.

songs.title: You That Know the Lord
lyrics: You that know the Lord is gracious,
Stands, of God elect and precious,
Laid that you may build there-on,
See that on that sure foundation
Towers that may tell forth salvation,
Kings and priests, by God anointed,
Shall you not declare His grace?
Tell the tidings of your birth,
To an old and weary earth.
Tell the praise of Him who called you
Broke the fetters that enthralled you,
Gave you freedom, peace, and sight
Tell the tale of sins forgiven,
Till the earth, in tune with heaven,

songs.title: There's a Spirit in the Air
lyrics: There's a Spirit in the air, telling Christians everywhere
"Praise the love that Christ revealed, living, working in our world."
Lose your shyness, find your tongue; tell the world what God has done
God in Christ has come to stay, we can see His pow'r today.
When believers break the bread, when a hungry child is fed
Praise the love that Christ revealed, living, working in our world.
Still His Spirit leads the fight, seeing wrong and setting right
God in Christ has come to stay, we can see His pow'r today.
When a stranger's not alone, where the homeless find a home,
Praise the love that Christ revealed, living, working in our world.
May His Spirit fill our praise, guide our thoughts and change our ways.
God in Christ has come to stay, we can see His power today.

songs.title: When Christ Was Lifted From the Earth
lyrics: When Christ was lifted from the earth His arms stretched out above
Through every culture, every birth, to draw an answering love.
Still east and west His love extends and always, near or far,
He calls and claims us as His friends and loves us as we are.
Where generation, class, or race divides us to our shame,
He sees not labels but a face, a person and a name.
Thus freely loved, tho' fully known, may I in Christ be free
To welcome and accept His own as Christ accepted me.

songs.title: What Joy It Is to Worship Here
lyrics: What joy it is to worship here,
Where God, who uses every gift,
Has room for all who come!
Yet are no two of us alike
And we must seek a common ground
If we would share His grace.

songs.title: In Christ There Is No East nor West
lyrics: In Him shall true heart everywhere
His service is the golden cord
Join hands, then, brothers of the faith,
Who serves my Father as a son
In Christ now meet both east and west,
In Him meet south and north;
All Christly souls are one in Him

songs.title: Lord of All Nations
lyrics: Lord of all nations, grant me grace
To love all people, every race,
And in each person may I see
My kindred loved, redeemed by Thee.
Break down the wall that would divide
Thy children, Lord, on every side.
My neighbor's good let me pursue;
Let Christian love bind warm and true.
Forgive me, Lord, where I have erred
By loveless act and thoughtless word.
Make me to see the wrong I do
Give me Thy courage, Lord, to speak
Should I myself the victim be,
With Thine own love may I be filled
And by Thy Holy Spirit willed,
That all I touch, where'er I be,
May be divinely touched by Thee.

songs.title: Holy Spirit, Gracious Guest
lyrics: Hear and grant our heart's request
For that gift supreme and best
Tongues of earth or heaven above,
Though I as a martyr bleed,
Give my goods the poor to feed,
All is vain if love I need
Love is kind and suffers long,
Love is pure and thinks no wrong,
Love than death it self more strong
Melting in the light of day;
Love will ever with us stay
Faith and hope and love we see
But the greatest of the three,
